confirmed_findings.name: Contact made with bent elbow close to torso
confirmed_findings.details: At the contact image (frame 37) your hitting arm is still noticeably flexed and the hand sits only a short distance in front of your chest; the shoulder line stays almost square rather than rotated through.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton frame 37 shows elbow well above 90° flexion and racket-hand close to the mid-line; torso rotation appears limited.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Striking with the arm folded reduces reach and shortens the lever, making it harder to generate a flat, fast drive and forces a late contact point that can lift the shuttle or lose control.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: On the final step, let the elbow unfold so the racket head and hand finish farther in front of your leading hip at impact.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Shadow backhand drives in front of a mirror: start from ready position, step and swing while checking that the hitting arm straightens and contact would occur just in front of the body line.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時手肘彎曲且靠近軀幹
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球影像（第37幀）中，你的擊球手臂仍然明顯彎曲，手僅距胸部不遠；肩膀線條幾乎保持方正，而不是旋轉。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 骨架影像第37幀顯示手肘彎曲超過90度，球拍手靠近身體中線；軀幹旋轉似乎有限。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 手臂彎曲擊球會減少擊球範圍並縮短槓桿，導致難以打出平直快速的抽球，並迫使擊球點延遲，可能導致球上升或失去控制。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在最後一步時，讓手肘展開，使球拍頭和手在擊球時更靠近前側髖部。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前練習反手平抽球：從準備姿勢開始，邁步並揮拍，同時檢查擊球手臂是否伸直，擊球點是否位於身體線前方。

confirmed_findings.name: Weight stays on rear foot at impact
confirmed_findings.details: Pressure on the right insole remains high through frame 37, while the left insole shows only a delayed rise after frame 50. Skeleton images also place your hips over the right leg at contact.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Right insole channels 1–4 stay near their peak until ~frame 45; left insole values remain low until after contact.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: A delayed weight transfer limits kinetic-chain power and slows your push back to base, costing both shot speed and court recovery.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Complete the step by driving your front (left) foot down just before contact so your centre of mass shifts forward on impact.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Multi-shuttle drive practice: coach feeds to your backhand; focus on landing the front foot and striking immediately, then pushing back to base.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時重心停留在後腳
zh_Hant.details: 在第37幀中，右腳鞋墊的壓力仍然很高，而左腳鞋墊的壓力在第50幀後才開始上升。骨架影像也顯示你的髖部在擊球時位於右腿上方。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 右腳鞋墊通道1–4的壓力值在大約第45幀前保持接近峰值；左腳鞋墊的壓力值在擊球後才開始上升。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 延遲的重心轉移限制了動力鏈的力量，減慢了回到場地中心的速度，影響了擊球速度和場地恢復。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 完成步伐時，在擊球前將前腳（左腳）用力踩下，使重心在擊球時向前移動。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 多球反手平抽球練習：教練餵球到你的反手位置；專注於落前腳並立即擊球，然後迅速回到場地中心。

confirmed_findings.name: Premature upper-arm muscle activation
confirmed_findings.details: Upper-arm EMG channels 1 & 2 spike sharply around frames 5–10, then settle before contact when only moderate activity appears.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Largest EMG peaks occur during early backswing; no comparable surge is present during frames 30–40 that include contact (red line).
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Tensing the arm early can lock the shoulder and elbow, reducing racquet-head speed and making timing adjustments harder during the actual hit.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Keep the arm relaxed in the take-back; feel the acceleration happen late, just as you step and extend into the shuttle.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Use a light resistance band: rehearse slow-to-fast backhand swings, focusing on delaying the main pull until the last third of the motion.

zh_Hant.name: 上臂肌肉過早激活
zh_Hant.details: 上臂肌電圖通道1和2在第5–10幀時急劇上升，然後在擊球前恢復到只有中等活動水平。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 最大的肌電圖峰值出現在早期回拍階段；在包括擊球的第30–40幀期間（紅線）沒有出現類似的峰值。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 手臂過早緊張可能會使肩膀和手肘僵硬，降低球拍頭速度，並使擊球時的調整更加困難。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在回拍時保持手臂放鬆；感受加速發生在最後階段，正好在邁步並伸展到球時。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 使用輕型阻力帶：練習從慢到快的反手揮拍，專注於將主要拉力延遲到動作的最後三分之一。

coaching_actions.cue: Reach out and straighten the hitting arm so contact occurs slightly in front of the leading hip.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: An earlier, more extended strike line maximises leverage for power and keeps the shuttle flat.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow swings in front of a mirror, freezing at ‘contact’ each time to confirm full arm extension and forward reach.

zh_Hant.cue: 伸展並伸直擊球手臂，使擊球點位於前側髖部稍前方。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更早且更延伸的擊球線可以最大化力量的槓桿作用，並保持球的平直飛行。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前進行影子揮拍，每次在‘擊球點’凍結動作，以確認手臂完全伸展並向前延伸。

coaching_actions.cue: Shift weight onto the front foot just before impact.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Early weight transfer drives the kinetic chain and sets you up for faster recovery.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Step-and-hit ladder drill: alternate quick steps into backhand drives, ensuring the front foot lands and bears weight before each swing.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球前將重心轉移到前腳。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 提前的重心轉移能驅動動力鏈，並為更快的恢復做好準備。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 步伐與擊球梯形訓練：交替快速步伐進行反手擊球，確保每次揮拍前前腳落地並承重。

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary:
Premature Leg Drive Activation; Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved; Quiet Eye Onset Failure; Vertical Gaze-Plane Drift; Quiet Eye Disruption at Contact; Heel-Biased Racket Foot at Contact; Prolonged Contact Fixation Freeze.

During your forward swing you keep your racket-arm elbow noticeably bent instead of letting it straighten as the hand travels toward the shuttle. Try to let the elbow open a little more in the last part of the swing so your forearm and upper arm form almost a straight line at contact. This longer lever helps you reach the shuttle earlier and lets the whole arm accelerate the racket smoothly. Through the whole motion—especially as you drive the racket forward—your rear-shoulder stabilisers stay almost silent. That leaves your shoulder complex less supported when the forces climb in the forward swing, which can let the racket path wander and cost both power and precision. Before you launch the arm, consciously set the shoulder by activating the back-of-shoulder muscles and keep a modest engagement as you accelerate through the shuttle.

Plant your racket-side foot firmly before you hit, stepping into the shot. Let the racket arm extend farther just before you strike, reaching forward while keeping the elbow relaxed rather than locked. Set your back-of-shoulder muscles (gently pull the shoulder blade down and back) before you start the forward swing and keep a light activation as you hit through. Anchor your gaze on the shuttle for a brief moment just before contact, then let it go immediately after the hit.

findings.name: Premature Leg Drive Activation
findings.details: backswing_to_forward_leg_peak_ratio=1.07407; upper=1.07123.

raw_evidence_results.name: Premature Leg Drive Activation
raw_evidence_results.evaluation: Problem: Premature Leg Drive Activation. The racket-side leg musculature (Quadriceps group) fires prematurely during the backswing rather than during the forward swing / lunge. This desynchronises the ground-reaction-force transfer up the kinetic chain: the leg impulse is dissipated before the upper body can utilise it, effectively decoupling the lower and upper body. The player loses the power contribution from the legs and compensates with excessive arm effort.

Therefore we cannot visually verify the reported 1.074 backswing-to-forward peak ratio.
visual_reviews.rationale: Because the phase boundaries are not explicitly annotated, the visual evidence does not allow a reliable, direct check that the highest quadriceps activation indeed occurs within the backswing window and subsides before forward-swing onset. The provided numerical summary claims a violation, but the task requires judging only from the attached visual evidence, which is ambiguous for this specific temporal criterion.
limitations: Phase timing not visually labelled

visual_reviews.observed_evidence: In player frames 38-46 (including the contact frame 41), the limb on the racket-side (same side as the striking arm) remains behind the body with the heel clearly off the ground or only the toes lightly touching. No visible downward settling or flat-footed plant occurs before or at the contact frame 41; the limb position and foot angle are almost unchanged through frames 38→46, indicating no distinct landing event.
visual_reviews.expert_comparison: The reference expert sequence is not used for timing; only player frames around contact were inspected. The expert images are therefore not determinative for the player’s foot-landing timing in this validation.
visual_reviews.rationale: The deterministic criterion flags a fault when the racket-side foot is still airborne or only partially weight-bearing (landing at/after contact). The visual sequence shows the racket-side foot never reaching a clear planted posture up to and including contact (frame 41) and even two frames later (frame 46). This directly aligns with the system’s finding that no step/landing occurred before contact.
limitations: Exact heel or toe pressure is not measurable from mesh view; judgement is based on apparent foot–ground gap and ankle posture.
Frame sampling at 10 fps may miss a brief landing event between frames.
Side identification relies on visible arm–leg pairing; some ambiguity remains if model orientation is mis-interpreted.

zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在球員的第38至46幀（包括擊球幀41）中，球拍側的肢體（與擊球手臂同側）保持在身體後方，腳跟明顯未著地或僅腳趾輕觸地面。在擊球幀41之前或當時未出現明顯的向下落地或平腳著地動作；肢體位置和腳部角度在第38→46幀期間幾乎未改變，表明沒有明顯的落地事件。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 參考專家序列未用於定時；僅檢查了球員在擊球周圍的幀。因此，專家圖像對於驗證球員的腳落地時間並不具有決定性。
zh_Hant.rationale: 確定性標準在球拍側腳仍在空中或僅部分承重（在擊球時或之後落地）時標記為故障。視覺序列顯示球拍側腳在擊球幀41之前及包括該幀時未達到明顯的落地姿勢，甚至在兩幀之後（幀46）也是如此。這與系統的發現直接一致，即在擊球前未發生步伐/落地。

在你的前揮動作中，球拍手臂的肘部明顯保持彎曲，而不是在手臂向羽毛球移動時伸直。嘗試在揮拍的最後部分讓肘部稍微打開，使前臂和上臂在擊球時幾乎形成一條直線。這樣的長槓桿可以幫助你更早接觸到羽毛球，並使整個手臂能夠平滑地加速球拍。在整個動作中——尤其是在你向前揮拍時——你的後肩穩定肌幾乎沒有啟動。這使得肩部結構在前揮動力增加時支撐不足，可能導致球拍路徑偏移，從而影響力量和精準度。在揮動手臂之前，有意識地通過啟動肩部後側肌肉來穩定肩部，並在加速通過羽毛球時保持適度的啟動。

在擊球前，穩固地踩下球拍側的腳，步入擊球。在擊球前讓球拍手臂進一步向前伸展，同時保持手肘放鬆，避免手肘鎖死。在開始前揮動之前，啟動肩部後側肌肉（輕輕將肩胛骨向下和向後拉），並在擊球時保持輕微啟動。在擊球前短暫地將視線固定在羽毛球上，然後在擊球後立即移開。

overview.title: Coaching review
overview.summary:
Premature Leg Drive Activation; Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved; Quiet Eye Onset Failure; Vertical Gaze-Plane Drift; Quiet Eye Disruption at Contact; Heel-Biased Racket Foot at Contact; Prolonged Contact Fixation Freeze.

During your forward swing you keep your racket-arm elbow noticeably bent instead of letting it straighten as the hand travels toward the shuttle. Try to let the elbow open a little more in the last part of the swing so your forearm and upper arm form almost a straight line at contact. This longer lever helps you reach the shuttle earlier and lets the whole arm accelerate the racket smoothly. Through the whole motion—especially as you drive the racket forward—your rear-shoulder stabilisers stay almost silent. That leaves your shoulder complex less supported when the forces climb in the forward swing, which can let the racket path wander and cost both power and precision. Before you launch the arm, consciously set the shoulder by activating the back-of-shoulder muscles and keep a modest engagement as you accelerate through the shuttle.

Plant your racket-side foot firmly before you hit, stepping into the shot. Let the racket arm extend farther just before you strike, reaching forward while keeping the elbow relaxed rather than locked. Set your back-of-shoulder muscles (gently pull the shoulder blade down and back) before you start the forward swing and keep a light activation as you hit through. Anchor your gaze on the shuttle for a brief moment just before contact, then let it go immediately after the hit.

visual_reviews.observed_evidence: In player frames 38-46 (including the contact frame 41), the limb on the racket-side (same side as the striking arm) remains behind the body with the heel clearly off the ground or only the toes lightly touching. No visible downward settling or flat-footed plant occurs before or at the contact frame 41; the limb position and foot angle are almost unchanged through frames 38→46, indicating no distinct landing event.
visual_reviews.expert_comparison: The reference expert sequence is not used for timing; only player frames around contact were inspected. The expert images are therefore not determinative for the player’s foot-landing timing in this validation.
visual_reviews.rationale: The deterministic criterion flags a fault when the racket-side foot is still airborne or only partially weight-bearing (landing at/after contact). The visual sequence shows the racket-side foot never reaching a clear planted posture up to and including contact (frame 41) and even two frames later (frame 46). This directly aligns with the system’s finding that no step/landing occurred before contact.
limitations: Exact heel or toe pressure is not measurable from mesh view; judgement is based on apparent foot–ground gap and ankle posture.
Frame sampling at 10 fps may miss a brief landing event between frames.
Side identification relies on visible arm–leg pairing; some ambiguity remains if model orientation is mis-interpreted.

zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 參考專家序列未用於定時；僅檢查了球員在擊球周圍的幀。因此，專家圖像對於驗證球員的腳落地時間並不具有決定性。
zh_Hant.rationale: 確定性標準在球拍側腳仍在空中或僅部分承重（在擊球時或之後落地）時標記為故障。視覺序列顯示球拍側腳在擊球幀41之前及包括該幀時未達到明顯的落地姿勢，甚至在兩幀之後（幀46）也是如此。這與系統的發現直接一致，即在擊球前未發生步伐/落地。

limitations.0: 無法從網格視圖測量確切的腳跟或腳趾壓力；判斷基於明顯的腳與地面間隙和腳踝姿勢。

relationships.explanation: Quiet Eye disruption at contact is the consequence of Quiet Eye never being established. If the gaze never achieves the low-variance, stable fixation state during the forward swing, it cannot be maintained through contact — the gaze continues fluctuating, and at the contact frame, this variance is measured as disruption. The absence of onset guarantees the presence of disruption.

zh_Hant.explanation: 接觸時的靜眼干擾是因為靜眼狀態從未建立。如果在前揮拍過程中視線未達到低變異、穩定的固定狀態，就無法在接觸時保持——視線會持續波動，而在接觸幀時，這種變異被測量為干擾。靜眼狀態未啟動就必然會出現干擾。

relationships.explanation: Your gaze is unstable as you meet the shuttle, but then remains fixed on the previous contact area for too long afterward. Together, these findings indicate poorly timed gaze control: your eyes do not stabilize early enough for contact and do not disengage promptly to locate the next play.

zh_Hant.explanation: 觸球時，你的視線仍然不穩定，但擊球後又在原來的接觸區域停留過久。這兩個問題共同顯示視線控制時序不理想：雙眼未能在觸球前及早穩定，也未能在擊球後適時轉移以尋找下一拍。

level2_coach_explanations.text: Premature Leg Drive Activation may contribute to Racket Foot Lands At or After Contact — Step-Into-Shot Not Achieved. Both errors were independently confirmed from raw evidence.
level2_coach_explanations.rationale: Premature leg drive disrupts the temporal coordination between the lunge step and the arm swing. The leg fires early, the step is initiated early, but the arm is not yet ready — leading to a temporal mismatch where the foot either lands too early (and the player is static at contact) or the step is mistimed entirely.

zh_Hant.rationale: 過早的腿部推動破壞了弓步與手臂揮拍之間的時間協調。腿部過早發力，步伐提前啟動，但手臂尚未準備好——導致時間錯配，腳要麼過早落地（球員在接觸時靜止），要麼步伐完全錯誤。

level2_coach_explanations.text: Quiet Eye Onset Failure may contribute to Quiet Eye Disruption at Contact. Both errors were independently confirmed from raw evidence.
level2_coach_explanations.rationale: Quiet Eye disruption at contact is the consequence of Quiet Eye never being established. If the gaze never achieves the low-variance, stable fixation state during the forward swing, it cannot be maintained through contact — the gaze continues fluctuating, and at the contact frame, this variance is measured as disruption. The absence of onset guarantees the presence of disruption.

zh_Hant.rationale: 接觸時的靜眼干擾是因為靜眼狀態從未建立。如果在前揮拍過程中視線未達到低變異、穩定的固定狀態，就無法在接觸時保持——視線會持續波動，而在接觸幀時，這種變異被測量為干擾。靜眼狀態未啟動就必然會出現干擾。

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Your racket arm could extend farther
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: Your racket-side elbow stays bent as the hand moves toward the shuttle. Open the elbow a little more in the final part of the swing so the arm is nearly straight at contact, improving reach and allowing smoother racket acceleration.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across frames 2 – 6 of the player sequence (player frames 38-46) your right elbow remains roughly 90°–110° flexed, with the forearm pointing downward. In the matching expert frames (expert frames 27-40) the expert’s elbow is much closer to full extension, with the forearm almost in line with the upper arm as the hand moves forward. The difference is consistent through the middle and late forward-swing images.
additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: Notice how the expert’s arm lengthens through frames 3, 5, 8 and stays long in frames 10-15, whereas your arm shows a persistent bend and the hand stays closer to the shoulder. The expert’s extended arm projects farther in front of the body, while yours remains tucked in.

zh_Hant.name: 你的持拍手臂未能充分伸展
zh_Hant.details: 手部移向羽毛球時，你的持拍側手肘仍然彎曲。請在揮拍最後階段把手肘再打開一些，讓手臂在觸球時接近伸直，從而增加擊球距離並讓球拍更順暢地加速。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在球員序列的第2至第6幀（球員幀38-46）中，你的右肘保持大約90°–110°的彎曲，前臂指向下方。而在對應的專家幀（專家幀27-40）中，專家的肘部更接近完全伸展，前臂幾乎與上臂成一直線，手向前移動。這種差異在中期和後期的前揮拍影像中是一致的。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 注意專家的手臂在第3、5、8幀中如何延長，並在第10-15幀中保持伸展，而你的手臂則持續彎曲，手靠近肩膀。專家伸展的手臂在身體前方延伸得更遠，而你的手臂則保持靠近身體。

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Your rear shoulder is not supporting the swing enough
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: The muscles behind your racket-side shoulder show too little stabilizing activity, especially during the forward swing. Gently set the shoulder blade down and back before accelerating, then maintain light support as you swing through the shuttle; this helps keep the racket path powerful and controlled.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: In the upper-arm EMG dashboard, Channel 3 (solid blue) remains near the baseline (≈0–0.1 unit unspecified) from frames 0-140, while the expert’s dashed trace shows clear, repeated peaks of ~0.3-0.4 units during each major movement burst—including the highlighted forward-swing window around frames 50-70. The player’s flat response persists across all four shaded phase windows, confirming a consistent under-activation rather than momentary noise.
additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert repeatedly recruits this upper-arm channel at each power phase, signalling active shoulder-stabiliser engagement that coincides with racket acceleration. Your trace lacks those peaks, showing that you are not matching the expert’s timing or magnitude of muscle use in that region.

zh_Hant.name: 你的後側肩膀未能充分支撐揮拍
zh_Hant.details: 持拍側肩膀後方的肌肉穩定作用不足，尤其在前揮階段。加速前先把肩胛骨輕輕向下、向後固定，揮拍穿過羽毛球時維持輕度支撐，有助保持球拍路徑有力而穩定。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在上臂肌電圖儀表板中，第3通道（實線藍色）在第0-140幀期間接近基線（≈0–0.1單位，單位未指定），而專家的虛線軌跡在每次主要動作爆發期間（包括第50-70幀的前揮拍窗口）顯示出明顯的重複峰值，約為0.3-0.4單位。球員的平坦反應在所有四個陰影階段窗口中持續，證實了穩定的啟動不足，而非短暫的噪音。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家在每個力量階段反覆啟動此上臂通道，顯示出與球拍加速一致的肩部穩定肌群參與。你的軌跡缺乏這些峰值，表明你未能匹配專家在該區域的肌肉使用時機和強度。

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Your non-racket arm does not move enough
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: During the forward swing and contact, your non-racket arm stays close to your torso with very little counter-movement. Let it move away from the body as the racket arm accelerates so it can balance your upper-body rotation and help you stay stable through the shot.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across the forward swing and contact, the non-racket arm remains near the torso while the racket arm moves through the stroke.
additional_visual_hypotheses.rationale: The non-racket arm should counterbalance the racket arm and help control trunk rotation. When it remains passive, the stroke relies more heavily on the hitting arm and the body is harder to stabilize for recovery.
additional_visual_hypotheses.actionable_cue: As the racket moves forward, let your non-racket hand move outward in the opposite direction, as if the two arms are balancing each other.
additional_visual_hypotheses.suggested_drill: Practise slow backhand shadow swings in front of a mirror. Keep both arms visible and make sure the non-racket hand moves away from the torso as the racket arm swings forward.

zh_Hant.name: 你的非持拍手動作不足
zh_Hant.details: 前揮和觸球時，你的非持拍手一直靠近軀幹，幾乎沒有作出反向平衡動作。持拍手加速時，讓非持拍手離開身體，協助平衡上半身旋轉，並在擊球過程中保持穩定。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在前揮和觸球過程中，持拍手完成揮拍，但非持拍手仍然停留在軀幹附近。
zh_Hant.rationale: 非持拍手應協助平衡持拍手並控制軀幹旋轉。當它保持被動時，擊球會更依賴持拍手臂，身體亦較難保持穩定並快速回位。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 球拍向前揮動時，讓非持拍手向相反方向伸出，想像雙臂正在互相平衡。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前慢速練習反手空揮。保持雙臂都能在鏡中看見，並確認持拍手向前揮動時，非持拍手會離開軀幹。

coaching_actions.cue: Plant your racket-side foot firmly before you hit, stepping into the shot.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Getting the foot down just before impact lets you drive power from the ground and improves stability for faster recovery.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow the net shot with a clear right-foot step and hold the lunge for a count before swinging, reinforcing early foot plant.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球前穩穩地將球拍側的腳踏實，並邁步進入擊球動作。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 在擊球前將腳放下，可以從地面獲得力量，並提高穩定性以加快恢復速度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 模擬網前擊球時，右腳清晰地向前邁一步，並在揮拍前保持弓步一個節拍，強化提前落腳的動作。

coaching_actions.cue: Let the racket arm extend farther just before you strike, reaching forward while keeping the elbow relaxed rather than locked.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A longer, smoothly extended arm increases reach and allows momentum to flow through the whole arm, improving power and shuttle control.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Practise slow-motion shadow strokes in front of a mirror, focusing on opening the elbow and finishing with the arm nearly straight and relaxed.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球前讓球拍手臂進一步向前伸展，同時保持手肘放鬆，避免手肘鎖死。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更長、更順暢地伸展手臂可以增加擊球範圍，並讓動能通過整個手臂流動，從而提高力量和對羽毛球的控制。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前練習慢動作模擬揮拍，專注於打開手肘，並以手臂幾乎伸直且放鬆的姿勢結束動作。

coaching_actions.cue: Set your back-of-shoulder muscles (gently pull the shoulder blade down and back) before you start the forward swing and keep a light activation as you hit through.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Consistent shoulder-stabiliser engagement keeps the swing plane steady and transfers energy efficiently to the racket.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Perform shadow swings after a few elastic-band external-rotation activations, focusing on feeling the shoulder blade anchored while the arm accelerates.

zh_Hant.cue: 在開始向前揮拍之前，先啟動肩胛後部的肌肉（輕輕將肩胛骨向下和向後拉），並在擊球過程中保持輕微的啟動狀態。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 穩定肩部穩定肌的啟動可以保持揮拍平面穩定，並有效地將能量傳遞到球拍上。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在進行幾次彈力帶外旋啟動後進行模擬揮拍，專注於感受肩胛骨固定的同時手臂加速。

coaching_actions.cue: Anchor your gaze on the shuttle for a brief moment just before contact, then let it go immediately after the hit.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A late-established Quiet Eye improves racquet-shuttle timing, while timely gaze release readies you for the opponent’s reply.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow swings with a suspended shuttle, holding focus for one count before contact and snapping eyes up to a wall target on follow-through.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球前短暫地將目光固定在羽毛球上，然後在擊球後立即移開視線。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 延遲建立的穩定視線可以改善球拍與羽毛球的時機配合，而及時移開視線則能讓你為對手的回球做好準備。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 模擬揮拍時使用懸掛的羽毛球，擊球前專注一個節拍，隨後在揮拍結束時將目光迅速移向牆上的目標。

The chain deviations indicate a need to address leg and arm coordination, particularly in the right side, to enhance overall performance.

1. **Chain Sequence Analysis**: 
   - **Foot**: Leading, which is beneficial for initiating the stroke.
   - **Leg**: Shows minor deviations, indicating possible leg strength or stability issues.
   - **Core/Trunk**: Leading, providing stability but may need refinement to better support the swing.
   - **Upper Arm**: Lagging, suggesting reliance on the right side, which could affect power generation.
   - **Forearm**: Lagging, contributing to control issues during the stroke.
   - **Wrist**: Major lag, highlighting a critical area for improvement in shuttlecock control.

2. **Training Recommendations**:
   - **Drill**: Implement a leg drive drill focusing on right leg strength and timing, ensuring proper hip and knee alignment.
   - **Performance Goal**: Achieve a consistent right-leg drive that enhances overall swing speed and power.
   - **Drill**: Introduce a core stability exercise to improve trunk rotation and foot placement.
   - **Performance Goal**: Maintain a balanced core stance during shots to enhance control.
   - **Drill**: Develop a forearm strengthening routine to address right-side reliance, focusing on pushing off the ground.
   - **Performance Goal**: Ensure a full upper-arm push-off for optimal power transfer.
   - **Drill**: Incorporate wrist control exercises to refine the wrist snap, focusing on timing and shuttlecock contact.
   - **Performance Goal**: Improve wrist snap accuracy and timing to maintain consistent shuttlecock control.

zh_Hant.summary:
該中級球員展現出中等的動力鏈質量，但某些方面仍有改進空間。他們的節奏和時機顯示出輕微的左側主導，這可能導致力量和控制的不平衡。動力鏈的偏差表明需要解決腿部和手臂的協調問題，特別是右側，以提升整體表現。

1. **動力鏈序列分析**：
   - **腳**：領先，這對於啟動擊球動作是有利的。
   - **腿**：顯示出輕微的偏差，可能表明腿部力量或穩定性問題。
   - **核心/軀幹**：領先，提供穩定性，但可能需要進一步改進以更好地支持揮拍動作。
   - **上臂**：落後，表明對右側的依賴，這可能影響力量的產生。
   - **前臂**：落後，導致擊球時的控制問題。
   - **手腕**：嚴重落後，突顯了在羽毛球控制方面需要改進的關鍵區域。

2. **訓練建議**：
   - **訓練**：實施一個專注於右腿力量和時機的腿部驅動訓練，確保髖部和膝蓋對齊。
   - **表現目標**：實現穩定的右腿驅動，以提升整體揮拍速度和力量。
   - **訓練**：引入核心穩定性訓練，以改善軀幹旋轉和腳步定位。
   - **表現目標**：在擊球時保持平衡的核心姿勢，以增強控制力。
   - **訓練**：制定一個前臂強化訓練計劃，解決右側依賴問題，專注於地面推力。
   - **表現目標**：確保完整的上臂推力以實現最佳的力量傳遞。
   - **訓練**：加入手腕控制訓練，改進手腕的彈動，專注於時機和羽毛球接觸。
   - **表現目標**：提高手腕彈動的準確性和時機，以保持穩定的羽毛球控制。

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary: Your backhand drive looks stable, but you tend to hit without much body rotation, leg drive, or hitting space. Adding torso turn, stepping for weight transfer, and creating room for the racket arm will help you load more power and control the shuttle better.

findings.name: Limited trunk rotation on backswing
findings.details: In frames 0-27 your shoulders stay almost square to the net; the chest does not coil away before the swing.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton lines for spine and shoulders remain nearly parallel to the hips from frame 0 (preparation) through frame 27 (backswing).
findings.why_it_matters: A fuller shoulder turn stores elastic energy and sets up a quicker whip forward, helping you generate a faster drive with less arm strain.
findings.actionable_cue: From preparation, consciously rotate your shoulders so your non-racket shoulder points toward the net before you start the forward swing.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow backhand drives in front of a mirror, exaggerating a 45-60° torso turn, then uncoil to swing, focusing on smooth rotation.

zh_Hant.name: 後擺時軀幹旋轉有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第0到27幀期間，你的肩膀幾乎保持與球網平行；胸部在揮拍前沒有向後旋轉。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 從第0幀（準備動作）到第27幀（後擺），脊椎和肩膀的骨架線幾乎與髖部保持平行。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更充分的肩膀旋轉可以儲存彈性能量，並為更快的前揮動作做好準備，幫助你以更少的手臂壓力產生更快的平抽球。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 從準備動作開始，有意識地旋轉肩膀，讓非持拍肩指向球網，然後再開始前揮動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前練習反手平抽球，誇張地進行45-60°的軀幹旋轉，然後解旋揮拍，專注於平滑的旋轉動作。

findings.name: Minimal lower-body weight transfer
findings.details: Your feet stay almost fixed and knees remain fairly straight from preparation through follow-through (frames 0-54).
findings.observed_evidence: Leg segments show little change in flexion or stance width; pelvis position stays nearly static across the sequence.
findings.why_it_matters: Driving off the legs and shifting weight forward adds power and helps you recover quickly for the next shot.
findings.actionable_cue: Add a small chasse or step into the shot, pushing off the rear leg as you swing.
findings.suggested_drill: Practise drive–step patterns: start in base, step across with your rear foot while executing the backhand drive, then recover to base.

zh_Hant.name: 下半身重心轉移不足
zh_Hant.details: 從準備動作到隨揮（第0到54幀），你的雙腳幾乎保持固定，膝蓋也相對筆直。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 腿部的彎曲程度和站姿寬度幾乎沒有變化；骨盆位置在整個動作序列中幾乎保持靜止。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 利用腿部的力量並將重心向前轉移，可以增加擊球力量，並幫助你快速恢復準備迎接下一拍。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球時加入一個小的交叉步或向前一步，並在揮拍時用後腿發力。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習平抽球的步法模式：從準備位置開始，用後腳跨步的同時進行反手平抽球，然後恢復到準備位置。

findings.name: Hitting with elbow tucked too close
findings.details: At contact (frame 41) your racket-side elbow stays close to the torso, limiting reach.
findings.observed_evidence: Elbow joint appears bent and positioned near the ribcage; forearm path is short before and after frame 41.
findings.why_it_matters: Crowding the stroke can shorten swing arc and reduce shuttle speed, and makes timing harder under pressure.
findings.actionable_cue: Create a small gap between elbow and ribs before you swing so the forearm can whip through freely.
findings.suggested_drill: Wall-bounce drill: stand half a step farther from the wall, focus on extending the racket arm outward then snapping through, keeping a fist-width gap from your side.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時手肘過於貼近身體
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球點（第41幀），你的持拍側手肘靠近軀幹，限制了擊球的伸展範圍。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 手肘關節彎曲，並靠近肋骨；在第41幀前後，前臂的運動路徑較短。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 擊球動作過於擁擠會縮短揮拍弧度，降低羽毛球的速度，並在壓力下使擊球時機更難掌握。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在揮拍前，讓手肘與肋骨之間留出一個小空隙，這樣前臂可以自由地揮動。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 牆壁反彈練習：站在離牆半步遠的位置，專注於將持拍手臂向外伸展，然後快速揮拍，保持手肘與身體側面有拳頭寬的距離。

zh_Hant.summary: 你的反手平抽球看起來很穩定，但你傾向於在擊球時缺乏身體的旋轉、腿部的推動力以及擊球空間。加入軀幹的轉動、步伐的重心轉移，以及為球拍手臂創造空間，將有助於你增加力量並更好地控制羽毛球。

overview.title: Coaching review
overview.summary: Your backhand drive looks stable, but you tend to hit without much body rotation, leg drive, or hitting space. Adding torso turn, stepping for weight transfer, and creating room for the racket arm will help you load more power and control the shuttle better.

zh_Hant.summary: 你的反手平抽球看起來很穩定，但你傾向於在擊球時缺乏身體的旋轉、腿部的推動力以及擊球空間。加入軀幹的轉動、步伐的重心轉移，以及為球拍手臂創造空間，將有助於你增加力量並更好地控制羽毛球。

confirmed_findings.name: Limited trunk rotation on backswing
confirmed_findings.details: In frames 0-27 your shoulders stay almost square to the net; the chest does not coil away before the swing.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton lines for spine and shoulders remain nearly parallel to the hips from frame 0 (preparation) through frame 27 (backswing).
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: A fuller shoulder turn stores elastic energy and sets up a quicker whip forward, helping you generate a faster drive with less arm strain.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: From preparation, consciously rotate your shoulders so your non-racket shoulder points toward the net before you start the forward swing.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Shadow backhand drives in front of a mirror, exaggerating a 45-60° torso turn, then uncoil to swing, focusing on smooth rotation.

zh_Hant.name: 後擺時軀幹旋轉有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第0到27幀期間，你的肩膀幾乎保持與球網平行；胸部在揮拍前沒有向後旋轉。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 從第0幀（準備動作）到第27幀（後擺），脊椎和肩膀的骨架線幾乎與髖部保持平行。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更充分的肩膀旋轉可以儲存彈性能量，並為更快的前揮動作做好準備，幫助你以更少的手臂壓力產生更快的平抽球。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 從準備動作開始，有意識地旋轉肩膀，讓非持拍肩指向球網，然後再開始前揮動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前練習反手平抽球，誇張地進行45-60°的軀幹旋轉，然後解旋揮拍，專注於平滑的旋轉動作。

confirmed_findings.name: Minimal lower-body weight transfer
confirmed_findings.details: Your feet stay almost fixed and knees remain fairly straight from preparation through follow-through (frames 0-54).
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Leg segments show little change in flexion or stance width; pelvis position stays nearly static across the sequence.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Driving off the legs and shifting weight forward adds power and helps you recover quickly for the next shot.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Add a small chasse or step into the shot, pushing off the rear leg as you swing.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Practise drive–step patterns: start in base, step across with your rear foot while executing the backhand drive, then recover to base.

zh_Hant.name: 下半身重心轉移不足
zh_Hant.details: 從準備動作到隨揮（第0到54幀），你的雙腳幾乎保持固定，膝蓋也相對筆直。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 腿部的彎曲程度和站姿寬度幾乎沒有變化；骨盆位置在整個動作序列中幾乎保持靜止。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 利用腿部的力量並將重心向前轉移，可以增加擊球力量，並幫助你快速恢復準備迎接下一拍。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球時加入一個小的交叉步或向前一步，並在揮拍時用後腿發力。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習平抽球的步法模式：從準備位置開始，用後腳跨步的同時進行反手平抽球，然後恢復到準備位置。

confirmed_findings.name: Hitting with elbow tucked too close
confirmed_findings.details: At contact (frame 41) your racket-side elbow stays close to the torso, limiting reach.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Elbow joint appears bent and positioned near the ribcage; forearm path is short before and after frame 41.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Crowding the stroke can shorten swing arc and reduce shuttle speed, and makes timing harder under pressure.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Create a small gap between elbow and ribs before you swing so the forearm can whip through freely.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Wall-bounce drill: stand half a step farther from the wall, focus on extending the racket arm outward then snapping through, keeping a fist-width gap from your side.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時手肘過於貼近身體
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球點（第41幀），你的持拍側手肘靠近軀幹，限制了擊球的伸展範圍。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 手肘關節彎曲，並靠近肋骨；在第41幀前後，前臂的運動路徑較短。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 擊球動作過於擁擠會縮短揮拍弧度，降低羽毛球的速度，並在壓力下使擊球時機更難掌握。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在揮拍前，讓手肘與肋骨之間留出一個小空隙，這樣前臂可以自由地揮動。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 牆壁反彈練習：站在離牆半步遠的位置，專注於將持拍手臂向外伸展，然後快速揮拍，保持手肘與身體側面有拳頭寬的距離。

coaching_actions.cue: Add a deliberate shoulder turn before initiating the forward swing.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: This single change stores energy and aligns your body for a faster, more stable drive.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Slow-motion shadow swings: pause at the top of your backswing, check that your non-racket shoulder is aimed toward the net, then uncoil and swing.

zh_Hant.cue: 在開始前揮動作之前，加入一個有意識的肩膀旋轉。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 這個單一的改變可以儲存能量，並使你的身體對準以進行更快、更穩定的平抽球。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作影子揮拍：在後擺的頂端暫停，檢查你的非持拍肩是否對準球網，然後展開身體並揮拍。

coaching_actions.cue: Step into the shot to transfer weight from rear to front foot.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Using the legs boosts power and positions you for quicker recovery.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Drive-step-recover footwork drill across mid-court, synchronising the step with the swing.

zh_Hant.cue: 踏入擊球動作，將重量從後腳轉移到前腳。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 使用腿部力量可以增加擊球的力量，並幫助你更快地恢復位置。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在中場進行平抽步伐練習，將步伐與揮拍動作同步。

coaching_actions.cue: Maintain a comfortable elbow gap during the forward swing.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Prevents a cramped action and allows a full wrist/forearm release for better shuttle speed.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Practise backhand drives against a wall, focusing on feeling space between elbow and torso throughout the swing.

zh_Hant.cue: 在前揮拍時保持舒適的肘部間距。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 避免動作受限，並允許手腕和前臂充分釋放，以提高球速。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習對牆的反手平抽球，專注於整個揮拍過程中保持肘部與軀幹之間的空間感。

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review
coaching_output.summary: Your backhand drive is consistent, but several key timing and posture details are limiting power and control. The video shows a small trunk turn, a fully straight hitting arm at contact, a weight-shift that happens after the shuttle is struck, and a momentary head lift. Addressing these areas should help you load your body better, transfer energy sooner, and keep the shuttle flatter and more accurate.

findings.name: Limited trunk rotation in preparation
findings.details: From frames 0-27 your shoulders and hips stay almost square to the net while the racket arm moves back. The torso shows only a small coil.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton images at frames 0, 14 and 27 display modest change in shoulder/hip orientation; hips remain nearly parallel to the front.
findings.why_it_matters: A deeper shoulder-hip turn stores elastic energy and positions the racket for a shorter, faster forward swing—key for a powerful, quick backhand drive.
findings.actionable_cue: During preparation, rotate your non-racket shoulder slightly forward and point your chest more towards the rear court before starting the forward swing.
findings.suggested_drill: Mirror shadow swings: face a mirror, exaggerate turning the torso so your back faces the net, then snap back to contact position while keeping feet stable.

zh_Hant.name: 準備動作中軀幹旋轉幅度有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第0到27幀之間，你的肩膀和臀部幾乎保持與球網平行，而球拍手臂向後移動。軀幹僅顯示出輕微的扭轉。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在第0、14和27幀的骨架圖像中，肩膀和臀部的方向變化不大；臀部幾乎保持與前方平行。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更深的肩膀和臀部轉動可以儲存彈性能量，並將球拍置於更短、更快的前揮位置——這是實現強力快速反手平抽球的關鍵。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在準備動作中，稍微向前旋轉非持拍手的肩膀，並將胸部更多地指向後場，然後再開始前揮動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 鏡子影子揮拍練習：面對鏡子，誇張地轉動軀幹，讓背部面向球網，然後迅速回到擊球位置，同時保持雙腳穩定。

findings.name: Elbow fully locked at contact
findings.details: At frame 41 your racket arm is almost completely straight with the elbow locked out as you meet the shuttle.
findings.observed_evidence: The contact-frame stick figure shows a straight line from shoulder through wrist, indicating minimal elbow flexion.
findings.why_it_matters: Locking the elbow reduces the wrist’s whipping action and makes timing harder, which can lead to reduced shuttle speed and limited directional control.
findings.actionable_cue: Aim to keep a slight bend in the elbow (about 15°) at contact, allowing the forearm and wrist to snap through.
findings.suggested_drill: Half-court wall drives: stand close to a wall and hit continuous backhand drives, focusing on a soft elbow and a late wrist snap.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時手肘完全鎖死
zh_Hant.details: 在第41幀時，你的球拍手臂幾乎完全伸直，手肘在擊球時鎖死。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 擊球幀的骨架圖顯示從肩膀到手腕是一條直線，表明手肘幾乎沒有彎曲。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 手肘鎖死會減少手腕的鞭打動作，並使時機更難掌握，這可能導致球速降低和方向控制受限。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球時保持手肘略微彎曲（約15°），允許前臂和手腕完成鞭打動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 半場牆壁平抽練習：站在靠近牆壁的地方，連續進行反手平抽球，專注於保持手肘柔軟並在最後一刻進行手腕鞭打。

findings.name: Weight shift happens after contact
findings.details: Pressure on the front (receiving) foot rises notably only after frame ~50, several frames after the contact at frame 41.
findings.observed_evidence: Both left and right insole traces show low values through contact, then a clear surge beginning roughly 10 frames later.
findings.why_it_matters: Late weight transfer means the stroke relies on the arm rather than whole-body momentum, limiting drive speed and making recovery slower.
findings.actionable_cue: Start pushing off your rear foot just before the swing, so your weight is already moving forward at contact.
findings.suggested_drill: Step-in drive drill: from a neutral stance, step with the rear foot and drive the shuttle, aiming to land on the front foot exactly as the racket meets the shuttle.

zh_Hant.name: 重心轉移發生在擊球之後
zh_Hant.details: 在第50幀左右，前腳（接球腳）的壓力顯著增加，而這是在第41幀擊球後的幾幀才發生的。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 左右鞋墊的壓力數據顯示，在擊球時壓力值較低，然後在大約10幀後出現明顯的上升。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 重心轉移過晚意味著擊球主要依賴手臂而非全身動力，這會限制平抽球的速度並使回位速度變慢。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在揮拍前稍微用後腳發力，這樣在擊球時你的重心已經開始向前移動。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 跨步平抽練習：從中立站姿開始，用後腳跨步並進行平抽球，目標是在球拍擊中球的同時，前腳剛好落地。

findings.name: Lower-body muscle activation lags upper-body
findings.details: Upper-arm channels peak around frames 10-15 and again near 40, whereas major leg channels (Leg EMG 1 & 4) spike later, peaking around frames 55-65.
findings.observed_evidence: EMG plots show distinct early peaks in upper EMG 1/2 before contact; leg EMG peaks are delayed until after contact.
findings.why_it_matters: For an efficient kinetic chain, force should start from the legs and hips, then flow to the arm. A reverse order can strain the shoulder and decrease racket speed.
findings.actionable_cue: Focus on initiating the stroke by driving through your legs and hips first, letting that momentum carry into the arm swing.
findings.suggested_drill: Medicine-ball side throws on the backhand side: emphasise pushing from the legs and rotating the torso before the arms release the ball.

zh_Hant.name: 下肢肌肉的啟動滯後於上肢
zh_Hant.details: 上臂通道在第10至15幀以及接近第40幀時達到峰值，而主要腿部通道（腿部肌電圖1和4）則在稍後達到峰值，約在第55至65幀之間。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 肌電圖顯示上肢肌電圖1/2在接觸前有明顯的早期峰值；腿部肌電圖的峰值則延遲到接觸後才出現。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 為了達到高效的動力鏈，力量應從腿部和臀部開始，然後流向手臂。反向順序可能會使肩膀承受壓力並降低球拍速度。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 專注於通過腿部和臀部的推動來啟動擊球，讓這股動能傳遞到手臂揮拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 藥球反手側拋：強調從腿部推動並旋轉軀幹，然後手臂釋放球。

findings.name: Head lifts during contact
findings.details: Gaze traces show a sharp vertical and horizontal shift exactly at frame 40-45, then stabilise.
findings.observed_evidence: Eye-gaze y drops steeply to its lowest point at frame ~40, coinciding with contact, then rises and steadies after.
findings.why_it_matters: Lifting or moving the head early can disturb balance and make the racket face less stable, affecting shuttle placement.
findings.actionable_cue: Keep your eyes level and steady through the hit—imagine watching the point of contact until the shuttle has left the strings.
findings.suggested_drill: Target-focus rally: pair up and rally only backhand drives while keeping your gaze fixed on a small mark on the opposite side of the net.

zh_Hant.name: 接觸時頭部抬起
zh_Hant.details: 視線追蹤顯示在第40至45幀時有明顯的垂直和水平移動，然後穩定下來。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 眼睛視線的Y軸在約第40幀時急劇下降至最低點，與接觸相吻合，然後上升並穩定。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早抬起或移動頭部可能會影響平衡，導致球拍面不穩定，影響羽球的落點。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球過程中保持眼睛水平並穩定——想像自己注視著接觸點直到羽球離開球拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 目標專注的回合練習：兩人配對進行回合練習，只打反手平抽球，同時將視線固定在球網對面的一個小標記上。

zh_Hant.summary: 你的反手平抽球很穩定，但一些關鍵的時機和姿勢細節限制了力量和控制。影片顯示你的軀幹轉動幅度較小，擊球時手臂完全伸直，重心轉移發生在擊球之後，並且有短暫的抬頭動作。解決這些問題應該能幫助你更好地蓄力，更早地傳遞能量，並使球路更平、更準確。

confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: For an efficient kinetic chain, force should start from the legs and hips, then flow to the arm. A reverse order can strain the shoulder and decrease racket speed.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Focus on initiating the stroke by driving through your legs and hips first, letting that momentum carry into the arm swing.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Medicine-ball side throws on the backhand side: emphasise pushing from the legs and rotating the torso before the arms release the ball.

zh_Hant.name: 下肢肌肉的啟動滯後於上肢
zh_Hant.details: 上臂通道在第10至15幀以及接近第40幀時達到峰值，而主要腿部通道（腿部肌電圖1和4）則在稍後達到峰值，約在第55至65幀之間。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 肌電圖顯示上肢肌電圖1/2在接觸前有明顯的早期峰值；腿部肌電圖的峰值則延遲到接觸後才出現。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 為了達到高效的動力鏈，力量應從腿部和臀部開始，然後流向手臂。反向順序可能會使肩膀承受壓力並降低球拍速度。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 專注於通過腿部和臀部的推動來啟動擊球，讓這股動能傳遞到手臂揮拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 藥球反手側拋：強調從腿部推動並旋轉軀幹，然後手臂釋放球。

confirmed_findings.name: Head lifts during contact
confirmed_findings.details: Gaze traces show a sharp vertical and horizontal shift exactly at frame 40-45, then stabilise.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Eye-gaze y drops steeply to its lowest point at frame ~40, coinciding with contact, then rises and steadies after.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Lifting or moving the head early can disturb balance and make the racket face less stable, affecting shuttle placement.
confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Keep your eyes level and steady through the hit—imagine watching the point of contact until the shuttle has left the strings.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Target-focus rally: pair up and rally only backhand drives while keeping your gaze fixed on a small mark on the opposite side of the net.

zh_Hant.name: 接觸時頭部抬起
zh_Hant.details: 視線追蹤顯示在第40至45幀時有明顯的垂直和水平移動，然後穩定下來。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 眼睛視線的Y軸在約第40幀時急劇下降至最低點，與接觸相吻合，然後上升並穩定。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早抬起或移動頭部可能會影響平衡，導致球拍面不穩定，影響羽球的落點。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球過程中保持眼睛水平並穩定——想像自己注視著接觸點直到羽球離開球拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 目標專注的回合練習：兩人配對進行回合練習，只打反手平抽球，同時將視線固定在球網對面的一個小標記上。

coaching_actions.cue: Load with a bigger shoulder-hip turn, then drive weight forward before contact.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Earlier body loading and timely weight transfer will let you generate power from the ground up instead of relying on the arm.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow + step-in sequence: slow-motion shadow 5 reps focusing on turn and push, then immediately hit 5 shuttle drives applying the same feeling.

zh_Hant.cue: 肩膀和臀部進行更大的轉動，然後在接觸前將重量向前推。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 提前進行身體負重和及時的重量轉移，能讓你從地面產生力量，而不是依賴手臂。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子+步入序列：慢動作影子練習5次，專注於轉身和推動，然後立即擊打5次羽球平抽球，應用相同的感覺。

coaching_actions.cue: Maintain a slight elbow bend at impact and finish the shot with a quick wrist snap.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A relaxed elbow improves racket-head speed and directional control.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Wall-drive sets of 30 seconds, counting only drives where you feel the elbow stay soft at contact.

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球時保持輕微的肘部彎曲，並以快速的手腕甩動完成擊球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 放鬆的肘部能提高球拍頭速度和方向控制。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 牆壁平抽球練習30秒，只計算在接觸時感覺肘部保持放鬆的擊球。

coaching_actions.cue: Keep your head still through contact.
coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Stable vision supports balance and consistent racket face.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Video yourself hitting 10 drives while focusing on a fixed spot; review to ensure minimal head movement.

zh_Hant.cue: 在接觸時保持頭部穩定。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 穩定的視線有助於平衡和球拍面的一致性。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 錄製自己擊打10次平抽球，同時專注於固定的點；回看影片以確保頭部移動最小化。

During your backswing, your left (non-racket) arm stays tucked near your ribs instead of lifting up and out. Give that arm some height so the elbow is roughly shoulder-level—this opens your chest, steadies your upper body and lets the shoulders coil fully before you start the swing. During your forward swing your right (racket) elbow stays noticeably bent instead of reaching a long, almost-straight position when the hand is above your head. Think of ‘spearing’ upward so the arm is long at the instant you would meet the shuttle; that extra reach lets the energy from your legs and trunk flow straight through the shoulder and into the racket. During your follow-through, your racket-side elbow folds quickly back into your ribs and stays there instead of travelling slightly out and forward. Keep that elbow relaxed and a hand-width clear of your body so the arm can finish its natural arc and you stay balanced for the next step. Start tightening the grip and pronating the forearm just before contact, not after. That earlier engagement lets the racket accelerate with a smooth whip and shortens recovery time. During your backswing you keep most of your body weight on your left, non-racket foot instead of settling over the right foot. Because that right foot never takes the full load, you have a weaker platform to drive upward and rotate when the swing starts.

Lift and stretch your left arm up and forward as you turn side-on. Reach all the way up and straighten your hitting arm just before you strike. Finish with your racket elbow clear of your ribs, letting the arm swing out before you bring it back in. Start your grip squeeze and forearm turn just before you meet the shuttle, not after. Settle your weight fully onto the right foot before you launch into the swing.

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review

zh_Hant.summary:
揮拍前上臂保持放鬆；後擺時視線保持水平；持拍腳前腳掌驅動力不足；擊球點較低；缺乏前腳掌制動推力；非持拍手臂位置過低且靠近軀幹；觸球時持拍手臂未完全伸展；持拍手臂肘部向軀幹塌陷而非保持舒適的距離；觸球後前臂/握拍動作啟動過晚；後擺時後腳加載不足。

在你的後擺動作中，你的左手（非持拍手）保持靠近肋骨，而不是抬高並向外伸展。將左手抬高至肘部大約與肩膀齊平的位置——這樣可以打開胸部，穩定上半身，並讓肩膀在揮拍前充分旋轉。在你的前揮動作中，你的右肘（持拍手）明顯保持彎曲，而不是在手位於頭上方時伸展至幾乎直的狀態。想像“向上刺”的動作，讓手臂在擊球瞬間伸展，這樣可以讓腿部和軀幹的力量直接通過肩膀傳遞到球拍。在你的揮拍後動作中，你的持拍手肘迅速折回肋骨並停留在那裡，而不是稍微向外和向前移動。保持肘部放鬆，與身體保持一個手寬的距離，讓手臂完成自然的弧線，並為下一步保持平衡。在揮拍後動作中，提前前臂和握拍肌肉啟動可以讓球拍以平滑的鞭打動作加速，並縮短恢復時間。在你的後擺動作中，你的大部分體重保持在左腳（非持拍腳）上，而不是完全落在右腳上。由於右腳未承受全部重量，你的起跳和旋轉平台較弱。

在轉身側身時，抬高並伸展你的左手臂向上和向前。擊球前將持拍手臂進一步向上伸展，同時保持手肘放鬆，避免鎖死。完成動作時，保持球拍肘部遠離肋骨，讓手臂向外揮動後再收回。握拍用力和前臂旋轉應在擊球前開始，而不是擊球後。起跳前將體重完全落在右腳上。

過早的上臂防護；過度抬高的視線超越；前腳掌推進力弱；起跳前中足停滯；擊球點較低；缺乏前腳掌制動推力；著地腳跟接觸時間過長；延長的雙腳站立恢復。

在你的後擺動作中，你的左手（非持拍手）保持靠近肋骨，而不是抬高並向外伸展。將左手抬高至肘部大約與肩膀齊平的位置——這樣可以打開胸部，穩定上半身，並讓肩膀在揮拍前充分旋轉。在你的前揮動作中，你的右肘（持拍手）明顯保持彎曲，而不是在手位於頭上方時伸展至幾乎直的狀態。想像“向上刺”的動作，讓手臂在擊球瞬間伸展，這樣可以讓腿部和軀幹的力量直接通過肩膀傳遞到球拍。在你的揮拍後動作中，你的持拍手肘迅速折回肋骨並停留在那裡，而不是稍微向外和向前移動。保持肘部放鬆，與身體保持一個手寬的距離，讓手臂完成自然的弧線，並為下一步保持平衡。在揮拍後動作中，你的前臂和握拍肌肉應在擊球前而不是擊球後開始握拍用力並旋轉前臂，提前啟動可以讓球拍以平滑的鞭打動作加速，並縮短恢復時間。在你的後擺動作中，你的大部分體重保持在左腳（非持拍腳）上，而不是完全落在右腳上。由於右腳未承受全部重量，你的起跳和旋轉平台較弱。

在轉身側身時，抬高並伸展你的左手臂向上和向前。擊球前將持拍手臂進一步向上伸展，同時保持手肘放鬆，避免鎖死。完成動作時，保持球拍肘部遠離肋骨，讓手臂向外揮動後再收回。握拍用力和前臂旋轉應在擊球前開始，而不是擊球後。起跳前將體重完全落在右腳上。

coaching_actions.cue: Lift and stretch your left arm up and forward as you turn side-on.

zh_Hant.cue: 轉身側向時，抬起並向前伸展你的左臂。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更高的引導臂能穩定你的軀幹並促進肩膀的完全旋轉，讓你獲得更大的擊球範圍和更流暢的力量傳遞。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子練習正手高遠球：在揮拍後擺時停頓，左肘保持在肩膀高度，然後完成動作。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A higher guiding arm stabilises your trunk and encourages full shoulder rotation, giving you more reach and a smoother power chain into the swing.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow forehand clears: pause in backswing with left elbow at shoulder height before completing the motion.

coaching_actions.cue: Swing forward and upward toward the shuttlecock, allowing your racket arm to extend smoothly to a high contact point at the moment of impact.

zh_Hant.cue: 揮拍向前上方迎球，讓持拍臂在觸球瞬間順暢延伸至高點。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 手肘由彎曲到瞬間順暢延伸，能發揮最大的鞭甩效應與高擊球點，同時避免手肘關節鎖死受傷。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子高遠球練習：專注於手肘由彎曲到向上順暢延伸的加速軌跡，擊球點維持在頭頂前上方最高點。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Transitioning smoothly from a bent elbow into an extended reach at impact generates maximum whip effect and height while preventing elbow hyper-extension injuries.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow clear drills: Focus on the acceleration arc from a bent elbow to a smooth upward extension, reaching your contact point at the highest position slightly in front of your head.

coaching_actions.cue: Finish with your racket elbow clear of your ribs, letting the arm swing out before you bring it back in.

zh_Hant.cue: 完成動作時，持拍肘部遠離肋骨，讓手臂向外揮動後再收回。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 完整且放鬆的揮拍後續動作能幫助肩膀平滑減速，並保持上半身平衡以便更快恢復。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子練習高遠球，專注於讓肘部完成動作後向外延伸，保持該位置一段時間後再回到準備姿勢。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A full, relaxed follow-through helps decelerate the shoulder smoothly and keeps your upper-body balanced for faster recovery.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow clears focusing on letting the elbow finish out and away, holding the position for a count before returning to base.

coaching_actions.cue: Keep your grip and forearm relaxed during the backswing, tightening your fingers and pronating your forearm only an instant before impact.

zh_Hant.cue: 引拍階段保持手掌與前臂放鬆，僅在擊球前的一瞬間快速旋前並扣緊拍柄。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 保持放鬆能獲得最大揮拍加速度，瞬間的「鬆-緊」轉換（手指發力）才能產生爆發性的拍頭速度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子高遠球練習：大聲唸出「放鬆（引拍）— 抓緊（觸球瞬間）— 放鬆（隨揮）」，體會瞬間扣緊發力的時機。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Staying relaxed allows for maximum racket acceleration, while a sudden 'relaxed-to-tight' transition at impact releases maximum explosive snap and racket head speed.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow clear drills: Vocalize 'Relax (backswing) – Squeeze (impact) – Relax (follow-through)' to master the exact timing of instantaneous grip activation.

coaching_actions.cue: Settle your weight fully onto the right foot before you launch into the swing.

zh_Hant.cue: 在揮拍前完全將體重轉移到右腳。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 穩固的後腳基礎讓你能夠有力地向上推進並旋轉進行高遠球。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子練習剪刀腳高遠球：向後跨步，重心停留在右腳，然後跳起並交換雙腳，專注於感受右腳的負重。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A firm rear-foot base lets you push up and rotate strongly into the clear.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow scissor-kick clears: step back, pause with weight over the right foot, then jump and switch feet, focusing on feeling that right-foot load.

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Non-racket arm kept too low and close to the trunk
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: During your backswing, your left (non-racket) arm stays tucked near your ribs instead of lifting up and out. Give that arm some height so the elbow is roughly shoulder-level—this opens your chest, steadies your upper body and lets the shoulders coil fully before you start the swing.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across player frames 1-6 the left elbow remains below the line of the shoulders and close to the torso; the forearm points downward. In the matching expert frames the left elbow sits clearly away from the body and near head height with the forearm vertical or slightly forward.

zh_Hant.name: 非球拍手臂保持過低且靠近軀幹
zh_Hant.details: 在你的後擺動作中，你的左手（非球拍手）保持靠近肋骨，而不是抬高並向外。讓手臂抬高到肘部大約與肩膀齊平——這樣可以打開胸部，穩定上半身，並讓肩膀在揮拍前完全旋轉。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在球員幀數1-6中，左肘保持在肩膀線以下並靠近軀幹；前臂指向下方。在匹配的專家幀中，左肘明顯遠離身體並接近頭部高度，前臂垂直或略微向前。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家的抬高非球拍手臂創造了一個寬闊且平衡的姿勢，從第一個取樣幀開始就可見並保持一致。你的手臂位置始終緊湊，因此輪廓看起來更窄，肩膀在每個對應時刻的旋轉程度也比專家少。

additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert’s raised non-racket arm creates a wide, balanced posture that is visible from the first sampled frame and stays consistent. Your arm position is compact throughout, so the silhouette looks narrower and the shoulders appear less rotated than the expert at each corresponding moment.

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Racket arm could extend farther at contact
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: During your forward swing your right (racket) elbow stays noticeably bent instead of reaching a long, almost-straight position when the hand is above your head. Think of ‘spearing’ upward so the arm is long at the instant you would meet the shuttle; that extra reach lets the energy from your legs and trunk flow straight through the shoulder and into the racket.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across sampled frames 1-3 (player source frames 41, 43, 45) the player’s right elbow angle remains visibly flexed, while the expert’s right arm in the matching frames is nearly straight and fully elevated. The difference is consistent through those forward-swing images and only narrows once both athletes move into follow-through.

zh_Hant.name: 球拍手臂在接觸時可以進一步伸展
zh_Hant.details: 在你的前揮動作中，你的右肘（球拍手臂）明顯保持彎曲，而不是在手臂位於頭部上方時達到幾乎筆直的長度。想像向上“刺”的動作，讓手臂在接觸羽球的瞬間保持伸展；這樣的額外伸展可以讓腿部和軀幹的能量直接通過肩膀傳遞到球拍。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在取樣幀1-3（球員幀41、43、45）中，球員的右肘角度明顯保持彎曲，而專家的右臂在匹配幀中幾乎是筆直且完全抬高的。這種差異在這些前揮動作的影像中始終一致，只有在兩位運動員進入隨後動作時才有所縮小。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家的手臂在幀46、48、50中顯示出從肩膀到手的連續線，表明在接觸時或接觸附近完全伸展。在相同編號的幀中，你的肘部仍然彎曲大約一半，因此你的擊球點更低且更靠近身體。匹配這種長距離伸展是你在比較這兩個序列時應注意的地方。

additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert’s arm shows a continuous line from shoulder to hand at frames 46, 48, 50, indicating full extension at or very near contact. In the same numbered pairs your elbow is still bent roughly halfway, so your striking point sits lower and closer to your body. Matching that long reach is what you should notice when comparing the two sequences.

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Racket-arm elbow collapses toward torso instead of staying comfortably away
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: During your follow-through, your racket-side elbow folds quickly back into your ribs and stays there instead of travelling slightly out and forward. Keep that elbow relaxed and a hand-width clear of your body so the arm can finish its natural arc and you stay balanced for the next step.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across player frames 2-6 (72, 91, 110, 129, 149) the right elbow is tucked against the torso with the forearm pointing down or across the stomach. In the matching expert frames the right elbow remains lifted away from the trunk and the forearm is more upright, showing a freer, longer follow-through.

zh_Hant.name: 球拍手臂肘部向軀幹內側塌陷，而不是保持舒適的距離
zh_Hant.details: 在你的隨後動作中，你的球拍側肘部迅速折回肋骨並停留在那裡，而不是稍微向外和向前移動。保持肘部放鬆並與身體保持一個手寬的距離，這樣手臂可以完成自然的弧線，你也能為下一步保持平衡。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在球員幀2-6（72、91、110、129、149）中，右肘靠近軀幹，前臂指向下方或橫過腹部。在匹配的專家幀中，右肘保持遠離軀幹，前臂更直立，顯示出更自由、更長的隨後動作。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家的右臂在接觸後繼續向上和向外移動，肘部與身體側面之間留有明顯的空間。你的手臂過早縮短路徑，這在任何專家幀中都未出現，並且在整個取樣的隨後動作序列中持續存在。

additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert’s right arm continues upward and outward after contact, leaving visible space between the elbow and the side of the body. Your arm shortens the path early, which is not seen in any expert frame and persists through the whole sampled follow-through sequence.

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Insufficient Rear-Foot Loading in Backswing
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: During your backswing you keep most of your body weight on your left, non-racket foot instead of settling over the right foot. Because that right foot never takes the full load, you have a weaker platform to drive upward and rotate when the swing starts.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: In frames F26 and F33 (backswing) the left foot shows high pressure across heel and forefoot (green/yellow), while the right foot remains mostly blue, indicating low loading. The expert at the same frames shows the opposite pattern with clear green on the right foot and minimal pressure on the left.

zh_Hant.name: 揮拍後擺時後腳負重不足
zh_Hant.details: 在揮拍後擺期間，你將大部分體重保持在左腳（非持拍腳）上，而不是轉移到右腳。由於右腳從未承受全部負重，你的揮拍起始時缺乏穩固的支撐來向上推動和旋轉。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在幀F26和F33（揮拍後擺）中，左腳在腳跟和前腳掌顯示高壓（綠色/黃色），而右腳大部分保持藍色，表明負重不足。專家在相同幀數中顯示相反的模式，右腳明顯呈綠色，而左腳壓力最小。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家在揮拍後擺早期將體重轉移到右腳，形成穩定的後腳基礎。你的曲線顯示體重在相同幀數中仍然集中在左腳，因此在揮拍向上之前未能達到後腳負重。

additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert shifts weight onto the right foot early in the backswing, creating a stable rear-foot base. Your trace shows the weight sitting on the left foot through the same frames, so you never match that rear-foot load before the swing up.

confirmed_level1_errors.name: Prolonged Heel Contact on Landing Foot

coaching_output.summary:
The kinetic chain demonstrates significant deviations, particularly in the wrist, upper arm, and core. Timing is off, with the feet leading and the trunk lagging behind. Lower-body support is inconsistent, especially on the left foot, impacting overall power and drive.  

1. **Foot:** Both feet show poor support, leading to inefficient push-offs.  
2. **Leg:** The lower body lacks sufficient drive, affecting the core's ability to rotate early.  
3. **Core:** Trunk rotation is delayed, causing the upper arm to overwork and the forearm to underpower.  
4. **Upper Arm:** Musculature is underutilized, reducing shoulder separation and wrist control.  
5. **Forearm:** Musculature is off, leading to a weaker grip and reduced wrist stability.  
6. **Wrist:** Acceleration is distal, causing a loss of shuttle contact and ground reaction inefficiency.  

- **Drill:** Implement a leg drive drill focusing on explosive power and foot placement.  
- **Performance Goal:** Achieve a 10% improvement in lower-body drive during shuttle play.  

- **Drill:** Incorporate core activation exercises to enhance trunk rotation and shoulder separation.  
- **Performance Goal:** Maintain a neutral spine and engage the core consistently during every movement.  

- **Drill:** Develop a wrist control drill to improve grip strength and timing, ensuring proper shuttle contact.  
- **Performance Goal:** Reduce wrist deviation to 5% of the stroke cycle during volleys.

zh_Hant.summary:
動力鏈顯示出顯著偏差，特別是在手腕、上臂和核心部位。時機不準確，腳步領先而軀幹滯後。下肢支撐不穩定，尤其是左腳，影響整體力量和推進力。

1. **腳部：** 雙腳支撐不佳，導致推進效率低下。
2. **腿部：** 下肢缺乏足夠的推進力，影響核心的早期旋轉能力。
3. **核心：** 軀幹旋轉延遲，導致上臂過度使用而前臂力量不足。
4. **上臂：** 肌肉未充分利用，減少肩膀分離和手腕控制。
5. **前臂：** 肌肉狀態不佳，導致握力減弱和手腕穩定性下降。
6. **手腕：** 加速集中於遠端，導致失去羽球接觸和地面反作用力效率。

- **訓練：** 執行專注於爆發力和腳步定位的腿部推進訓練。
- **表現目標：** 在羽球比賽中實現下肢推進力提升10%。

- **訓練：** 加入核心激活練習以增強軀幹旋轉和肩膀分離。
- **表現目標：** 在每次動作中保持中立脊椎並穩定啟動核心。

- **訓練：** 開發手腕控制訓練以改善握力和時機，確保正確的羽球接觸。
- **表現目標：** 在截擊中將手腕偏差減少至動作周期的5%。

coaching_output.summary: Your swing reaches the shuttle, but the body stays almost square to the net, the non-racket arm stays low, and the legs hardly shift weight. Adding trunk rotation, an active non-racket arm, and a clear weight-transfer step will help you create a longer swing path and easier recovery.

findings.name: Limited trunk rotation
findings.details: In frames 14 and 27 your shoulders remain nearly parallel to the camera instead of turning so the racket shoulder moves well behind the non-racket shoulder.

zh_Hant.name: 軀幹旋轉有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第14幀和第27幀中，你的肩膀幾乎與攝影機平行，而不是轉動使持拍肩膀遠遠超過非持拍肩膀。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在回拍時，想像你的背部面向球網，讓胸部指向側面。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更深的轉動可以儲存彈性能量並延長揮拍路徑，讓你在擊高遠球時有更多的時間和力量。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子揮拍：站側身，完全轉動肩膀向後，然後揮拍過去，不擊球，重複10次為一組。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在第0幀、第14幀和第27幀之間，肩膀線條幾乎沒有變化；軀幹保持正對而不是向外旋轉。

findings.actionable_cue: During the take-back, think of showing your back to the net so your chest points sideways.
findings.why_it_matters: A deeper turn stores elastic energy and lengthens the swing path, giving you more time and power for the clear.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow swings: stand sideways, turn your shoulders fully back, then swing through without a shuttle, repeating 10× sets.
findings.observed_evidence: The shoulder line changes very little between frames 0, 14 and 27; the torso stays square rather than rotating away.

findings.name: Non-racket arm inactive
findings.details: Throughout the backswing (frames 14, 27) the left arm hangs close to the body instead of lifting for balance and alignment.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手不活躍
zh_Hant.details: 在回拍過程中（第14幀、第27幀），左手臂靠近身體垂下，而不是抬起來保持平衡和對齊。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 當你將球拍向後拉時，抬起左手臂指向羽毛球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 伸展的非持拍手可以平衡持拍手，並幫助設定肩膀的旋轉，從而提高準確性和穩定性。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 鏡子練習：練習在轉身時將非持拍手臂抬到肩膀高度，並在鏡子中檢查對稱性。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 左手臂線條保持低垂且靠近；當持拍手臂向後時，沒有看到向上的伸展動作。

findings.actionable_cue: As you pull the racket back, raise your left arm to point toward the shuttle.
findings.why_it_matters: An extended non-racket arm counterbalances the racket arm and helps set shoulder rotation, improving accuracy and stability.
findings.suggested_drill: Mirror work: practise raising the non-racket arm to shoulder height while turning, checking in a mirror for symmetry.
findings.observed_evidence: Left arm line stays low and close; no upward reach is visible while racket arm goes back.

findings.name: Minimal weight transfer
findings.details: Between frames 27, 45 and into the follow-through, the feet positions and hip line stay almost unchanged.

zh_Hant.name: 重心轉移最小
zh_Hant.details: 在第27幀、第45幀以及隨後的揮拍過程中，雙腳的位置和髖部線條幾乎沒有改變。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 當球拍開始向前揮動時，從後腿發力推進，讓身體重心移向擊球側。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 將重心從後腳轉移到前腳（或在後場進行交叉步）可以為擊球增加動力，並為下一拍做好準備。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子交叉步高遠球：從後場開始，從後腿發力，空中換腳，落地時面向前方，每組重複8次。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 腿部角度和髖部對齊保持不變；沒有顯示出後腿的明顯步伐或推力。

findings.actionable_cue: Push off your back leg as the racket starts forward so your body weight moves toward the hitting side.
findings.why_it_matters: Shifting weight from rear to front foot (or performing a scissor kick if rear-court) adds momentum to the stroke and prepares you for the next shot.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow scissor-kick clears: start deep, push off rear leg, switch feet in the air, land facing forward, repeat 8× per set.
findings.observed_evidence: Leg angles and hip alignment remain constant; no visible step or push off the rear leg is shown.

findings.name: Short follow-through path
findings.details: After contact (frames 54-95) the racket arm stops around shoulder level and the torso remains upright rather than allowing the arm to wrap across the body.

zh_Hant.name: 揮拍路徑短
zh_Hant.details: 擊球後（第54至95幀），球拍手臂停在肩膀高度附近，身體保持直立，而不是讓手臂繞過身體。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 讓球拍完成動作時越過身體的另一側，手掌停在非持拍手的髖部附近。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 放鬆且更長的隨後動作有助於完成動力鏈，並減少肩膀的壓力。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作高遠球：以50%的速度揮拍，專注於完整且放鬆的隨後動作。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 球拍手臂部分在擊球線之外幾乎沒有延續；身體角度在隨後動作幀中變化很小。

findings.actionable_cue: Let the racket finish across the opposite side of your body, palm finishing near your non-racket hip.
findings.why_it_matters: A relaxed, longer follow-through helps complete the kinetic chain and reduces strain on the shoulder.
findings.suggested_drill: Slow-motion clears: swing at 50 % speed focusing only on a full, relaxed follow-through.
findings.observed_evidence: Racket-arm segment shows little continuation beyond the hitting line; torso angle changes minimally in follow-through frames.

confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Shadow scissor-kick clears: start deep, push off rear leg, switch feet in the air, land facing forward, repeat 8× per set.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Leg angles and hip alignment remain constant; no visible step or push off the rear leg is shown.

confirmed_findings.name: Short follow-through path
confirmed_findings.details: After contact (frames 54-95) the racket arm stops around shoulder level and the torso remains upright rather than allowing the arm to wrap across the body.

zh_Hant.name: 揮拍路徑短
zh_Hant.details: 擊球後（第54至95幀），球拍手臂停在肩膀高度附近，身體保持直立，而不是讓手臂繞過身體。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 讓球拍完成動作時越過身體的另一側，手掌停在非持拍手的髖部附近。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 放鬆且更長的隨後動作有助於完成動力鏈，並減少肩膀的壓力。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作高遠球：以50%的速度揮拍，專注於完整且放鬆的隨後動作。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 球拍手臂部分在擊球線之外幾乎沒有延續；身體角度在隨後動作幀中變化很小。

confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Let the racket finish across the opposite side of your body, palm finishing near your non-racket hip.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: A relaxed, longer follow-through helps complete the kinetic chain and reduces strain on the shoulder.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Slow-motion clears: swing at 50 % speed focusing only on a full, relaxed follow-through.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Racket-arm segment shows little continuation beyond the hitting line; torso angle changes minimally in follow-through frames.

coaching_output.summary: Your swing sequence is smooth, but the data show three areas that can unlock more power and consistency: (1) keeping the non-racket arm active for balance, (2) engaging the legs earlier for upward drive, and (3) stabilising your gaze before contact. Focusing on these points will help you generate more racket head speed and hit deeper, more controlled clears.

findings.name: Non-racket arm drops too early
findings.details: By the contact frame (45) your non-racket arm has already fallen behind your body, whereas in the backswing frame (27) it was still forward and available for balance.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手過早下垂
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球幀（45）時，你的非持拍手已經落在身體後方，而在揮拍準備幀（27）時，它仍然向前並有助於平衡。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 保持非持拍手指向羽毛球，直到擊球前一刻，然後讓它自然收回。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 讓手臂過早下垂會減少反向旋轉和軀幹穩定性，這可能限制力量傳遞並使擊球後更難控制身體平衡。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前進行影子高遠球練習，停留在‘擊球’位置，檢查非持拍手是否仍然向上並向前。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 骨架幀27→45顯示非持拍手從向前抬起的位置移動到擊球前垂在身側的位置。

findings.actionable_cue: Keep your non-racket hand pointing toward the shuttle until just before you strike, then let it fold in naturally.
findings.why_it_matters: Allowing the arm to drop early reduces counter-rotation and torso stability, which can limit power transfer and make it harder to control body balance after the shot.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow-clears in front of a mirror, freezing at ‘contact’ to check that the non-racket hand is still up and forward.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton frames 27→45 show the non-racket arm moving from a forward-raised position to hanging by your side before shuttle contact.

findings.name: Leg drive starts after, not before, contact
findings.details: Most of your leg-muscle activity (Leg EMG 2 & 3) and the big rise in front-foot pressure occur mainly after frame 50, while contact is at frame 45. Skeleton images show limited knee and hip extension at contact.

zh_Hant.name: 腿部推力在擊球後才開始，而非擊球前
zh_Hant.details: 大部分腿部肌肉活動（腿部EMG 2和3）以及前腳壓力的大幅上升主要發生在幀50之後，而擊球發生在幀45。骨架圖像顯示擊球時膝蓋和髖部的伸展有限。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 當你開始揮拍向前時，同時啟動後腿的推力，這樣你的身體會在擊球前上升並將重量轉移到前腳。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 如果後腳的推力開始得太晚，你將無法利用腿部產生向上和向前的動力，迫使手臂和肩膀承受更多壓力，並減少球的飛行距離。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 多球高遠球練習：從分腿起跳開始，誇張地提前推動後腳並完成全程揮拍，目標是在擊球時落在前腳上。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 腿部EMG曲線在大約幀60之前保持低水平；左腳墊壓力通道在擊球後達到峰值；膝蓋在幀39–45期間僅略微彎曲。

findings.actionable_cue: Begin your back-leg push as you start the racket’s forward motion, so your body rises and transfers weight onto the front foot just before contact.
findings.why_it_matters: If the push from the back foot starts late, you miss out on using your legs to generate upward and forward momentum, forcing the arm and shoulder to work harder and reducing shuttle length.
findings.suggested_drill: Multi-shuttle clear drill: from a split-step, exaggerate early back-foot push and full follow-through, aiming to land on the front foot at contact.
findings.observed_evidence: Leg EMG curves stay low until ~frame 60; left-insole channels peak just after contact; knees appear only slightly flexed through frames 39–45.

findings.name: Limited hip-shoulder turn in backswing
findings.details: Between frames 0 and 27 your shoulders rotate slightly, but the hips remain almost square to the net, reducing trunk coil.

zh_Hant.name: 揮拍準備時髖部和肩部的轉動有限
zh_Hant.details: 在幀0到27之間，你的肩膀略有旋轉，但髖部幾乎保持正對球網，減少了軀幹的扭轉。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 當球拍向後揮時，讓你的髖部和肩膀一起轉動，使胸部面向邊線，然後再展開動作。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更充分的轉動可以在核心部位儲存彈性能量並延長揮拍路徑，幫助你用相同的手臂力量打出更高更深的高遠球。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 進行影子頭頂高遠球練習，在揮拍準備的最高點暫停，檢查你的肚臍是否指向側面，然後再開始揮拍。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在揮拍準備幀中，骨盆的方向僅有輕微變化，而肩膀相對於雙腳的轉動幅度有限。

findings.actionable_cue: As the racket goes back, let your hips and shoulders turn so your chest faces the sideline before unwinding.
findings.why_it_matters: A fuller turn stores elastic energy in the core and lengthens the swing path, helping you hit higher and deeper clears with the same arm effort.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow overhead clears with a pause at the top of the backswing—check that your navel points sideways before initiating the swing.
findings.observed_evidence: In backswing frames, pelvis orientation changes only marginally while shoulder lines turn modestly relative to the feet.

findings.name: Gaze instability before contact
findings.details: Gaze X and Y signals fluctuate markedly from frames 0–40 and settle only after contact.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球前視線不穩定
zh_Hant.details: 視線的 X 和 Y 信號在第 0 至 40 幀波動顯著，僅在接觸後才穩定下來。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 提前追蹤羽毛球，然後在移動到位並揮拍時鎖定眼睛在其飛行路徑上。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 不穩定的視線可能會使判斷羽毛球的高度和時機變得困難，增加偏心接觸和深度不一致的風險。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 教練拋出簡單的高球；在接觸前一瞬間喊出「打」，以加強穩定的視覺追蹤。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 眼睛視線圖顯示在準備和早期揮拍階段有多次大幅度的水平和垂直移動，僅在接觸後才平滑。

findings.actionable_cue: Track the shuttle early, then lock your eyes on its flight path as you move into position and swing.
findings.why_it_matters: An unsteady gaze can make it harder to judge shuttle height and timing, increasing the risk of off-centre contact and inconsistent depth.
findings.suggested_drill: Coach tosses easy high shuttles; call out ‘hit’ a split-second before contact to reinforce steady visual tracking.
findings.observed_evidence: Eye-gaze plots show multiple large horizontal and vertical shifts during preparation and early swing, smoothing out only post-contact.

coaching_output.summary:
Upper-Arm Overdrive in Backswing; Hyper-elevated Gaze Overshoot; Weak Forefoot Push-Off; Midfoot Stall Before Take-Off; Ground-Bound Contact (No Air Time); Low Contact Point; Bent Elbow at Impact; Absent Forefoot Braking Push; Extended Double-Stance Recovery.

During your forward swing your right elbow stays noticeably bent instead of reaching almost straight just before the moment of contact. Make a conscious effort to let the elbow open farther without locking it, so that your forearm, wrist and racket can travel in a longer arc above and slightly in front of your head. The extra reach gives you a higher contact point and lets the rest of the body rotation transfer more cleanly into the shuttle. During your forward swing, your main forearm muscles stay almost silent until after the racket is already moving past the shuttle. Engage that forearm earlier so the wrist and elbow drive contribute to the racquet-head speed instead of just following the shoulder.

Reach higher and let your racket arm extend farther just before contact, keeping the elbow relaxed rather than locked. Snap your forearm and wrist a fraction earlier in the swing.

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review

zh_Hant.summary:
上臂過度驅動於後擺；視線過度抬高；前腳掌推進力弱；起跳前中腳停滯；地面接觸（無空中時間）；擊球點低；擊球時手肘彎曲；缺乏前腳掌制動推進；延長雙腳站立恢復。

在你的前擺動過程中，右手肘在擊球前明顯保持彎曲，請有意識地讓手肘伸展，這樣你的前臂、手腕和球拍可以在頭部上方並稍微向前形成更長的弧線。額外的伸展可以讓你獲得更高的擊球點，並使身體旋轉的力量更清晰地傳遞到羽毛球上。在前擺動過程中，你的主要前臂肌肉幾乎沒有作用，直到球拍已經越過羽毛球後才開始發力。請更早地啟動前臂，讓手腕和手肘的動作能夠為球拍頭速度提供動力，而不僅僅是跟隨肩膀的動作。

在擊球前，請將持拍手臂進一步向上伸展，同時保持手肘放鬆，避免鎖死。在揮拍過程中稍微提前用力甩動前臂和手腕。

overview.title: Coaching review
overview.summary:
Upper-Arm Overdrive in Backswing; Hyper-elevated Gaze Overshoot; Weak Forefoot Push-Off; Midfoot Stall Before Take-Off; Ground-Bound Contact (No Air Time); Low Contact Point; Bent Elbow at Impact; Absent Forefoot Braking Push; Extended Double-Stance Recovery.

During your forward swing your right elbow stays noticeably bent instead of reaching almost straight just before the moment of contact. Make a conscious effort to let the elbow open farther without locking it, so that your forearm, wrist and racket can travel in a longer arc above and slightly in front of your head. The extra reach gives you a higher contact point and lets the rest of the body rotation transfer more cleanly into the shuttle. During your forward swing, your main forearm muscles stay almost silent until after the racket is already moving past the shuttle. Engage that forearm earlier so the wrist and elbow drive contribute to the racquet-head speed instead of just following the shoulder.

Reach higher and let your racket arm extend farther just before contact, keeping the elbow relaxed rather than locked. Snap your forearm and wrist a fraction earlier in the swing.

The extra reach gives you a higher contact point and lets the rest of the body rotation transfer more cleanly into the shuttle.

additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across lower-arm EMG dashboard channels CH1-CH4 the expert trace (green dashed) shows a clear burst that begins around frame 25-30 and peaks through the forward-swing window. additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert fires the lower-arm muscles just before and through contact, producing a wide, tall activation hill. Your trace stays flat at that moment, which means the lower arm is not adding power at the key instant. The visual gap between your blue lines and the expert’s green lines is largest exactly where the expert peak sits.

coaching_output.summary:
The player’s kinetic chain demonstrates a moderate level of quality, with some areas requiring refinement. The timing and sequencing of movements are inconsistent, particularly in the foot and leg phases, which impede smoothness and efficiency. The core and upper-arm contributions are weaker than optimal, suggesting a need for stronger push-off and hip rotation. While there are moments of effective lower-body support, the overall rhythm is uneven, affecting the player’s ability to maintain stability and power during the stroke.

1. **Foot -> Leg -> Core -> Upper Arm -> Forearm -> Wrist**:  
   The foot and leg phases show significant lag, particularly in the right-foot support and left-thigh musculature. This creates a delay in initiating the swing, leading to a lack of rhythm and reduced efficiency. The core and upper-arm contributions are weaker, with the trunk/core and upper-arm musculature deviating from the ideal proximal-to-distal transfer. The forearm and terminal wrist demonstrate a major deviation, with an early wrist snap and forearmed whipping action that disrupts the shuttle. These issues collectively hinder the player’s ability to generate consistent power and control.

2. **Training Recommendations**:  
   - **Hip Rotation Drill**: Perform a series of controlled hip rotations with a weighted ball, focusing on a strong, proximal-to-distal transfer to anchor the lower body. The goal is to achieve a more efficient and timely hip rotation to align with the foot and leg movements.  
   - **Wrist Snap Correction Drill**: Use a shuttlecock to practice a controlled wrist snap, emphasizing the importance of a later snap to maintain shuttle contact and improve power transfer. The objective is to reduce wrist overextension and enhance wrist stability.  
   - **Push-Off Drills**: Conduct plyometrics and stepping exercises to strengthen the forefoot muscles and improve the push-off phase. The focus is on generating a stronger, more explosive drive to enhance hip-shoulder separation and overall power output.

zh_Hant.summary:
球員的動力鏈展現出中等水平的質量，但某些方面需要改進。動作的時間和順序不一致，特別是在腳部和腿部階段，影響了流暢性和效率。核心和上臂的貢獻較弱，表明需要更強的蹬地和髖部旋轉。雖然下肢支撐偶有有效表現，但整體節奏不均，影響球員在擊球時保持穩定性和力量的能力。

1. **腳 -> 腿 -> 核心 -> 上臂 -> 前臂 -> 手腕**：  
   腳部和腿部階段顯示出顯著的滯後，特別是在右腳支撐和左大腿肌肉群方面。這導致揮拍的啟動延遲，進而缺乏節奏和效率。核心和上臂的貢獻較弱，軀幹/核心和上臂肌肉群偏離了理想的近端到遠端的力量傳遞。前臂和末端手腕表現出重大偏差，早期的手腕甩動和前臂鞭打動作干擾了羽毛球的飛行。這些問題共同阻礙了球員穩定產生力量和控制的能力。

2. **訓練建議**：  
   - **髖部旋轉訓練**：使用加重球進行一系列受控的髖部旋轉，專注於強有力的近端到遠端力量傳遞以穩固下肢。目標是實現更高效和及時的髖部旋轉，與腳部和腿部動作保持一致。  
   - **手腕甩動修正訓練**：使用羽毛球練習受控的手腕甩動，強調延遲甩動的重要性，以保持羽毛球接觸並改善力量傳遞。目標是減少手腕過度伸展並增強手腕穩定性。  
   - **蹬地訓練**：進行跳躍訓練和步伐練習以增強前腳肌肉並改善蹬地階段。重點是產生更強、更爆發性的驅動力，以提升髖肩分離和整體力量輸出。

findings.name: Minimal trunk and hip rotation
findings.details: During frames 14-27 your shoulders and hips stay almost square; the torso shows only a small turn while the racket arm moves back.

zh_Hant.name: 軀幹和髖部旋轉幅度有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第14到27幀期間，你的肩膀和髖部幾乎保持平行；軀幹僅有輕微的轉動，而持拍手臂向後移動。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 當你將球拍向後拉時，讓肚臍和胸部轉動，使非持拍肩膀指向羽球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 如果缺乏更大的軀幹纏繞，你主要依賴手臂發力，這可能會限制力量，並在後場受壓時增加擊球的難度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢速模擬揮拍並誇張肩膀和髖部的轉動：側身站立，完全旋轉，然後揮拍，10次一組，共3組。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 肩膀和髖部的骨架線條幾乎與螢幕平行，而不是進行纏繞動作。

findings.actionable_cue: As you take the racket back, allow your belly-button and chest to turn so the non-racket shoulder points toward the shuttle.
findings.why_it_matters: Without a bigger torso coil you rely mainly on the arm, which can limit power and make timing harder when you are under pressure in the rearcourt.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow swing with slow, exaggerated shoulder-hip turn: set up sideways, rotate fully, then swing, 10 reps × 3 sets.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton lines for both shoulders and hips remain nearly parallel to the screen rather than winding up.

findings.name: Limited weight transfer / no scissor step
findings.details: Across all frames the feet stay almost parallel and shoulder-width; there is no visible back-to-front leg switch or push-off.

zh_Hant.name: 重量轉移有限 / 沒有剪步動作
zh_Hant.details: 在所有幀中，雙腳幾乎保持平行且與肩同寬；沒有明顯的前後腿交換或蹬地動作。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球時用後腿蹬地，並在空中交換雙腳，著地時用相反的腿支撐。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 剪步或弓步有助於產生向上的力量，平衡空中的身體，並讓你在高遠球後更快恢復準備姿勢。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 模擬高遠球並標記著地點：跳起、剪步、前腳著地，然後恢復，左右各8次。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 從第0幀到第54幀，腿部線條顯示相似的位置；沒有交叉或著地變化的跡象。

findings.actionable_cue: Push off your back leg and switch your feet in the air as you hit, landing on the opposite leg.
findings.why_it_matters: A scissor or lunge helps generate upward force, balances the body in the air, and gets you ready to recover after the clear.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow clears with a marked landing spot: jump, scissor, land on front foot, then recover, 8 reps each side.
findings.observed_evidence: Leg lines show similar positions from frame 0 through 54; no crossing or landing change is seen.

findings.name: Early arm flexion and short follow-through
findings.details: At frame 46 the hitting elbow is still noticeably bent and by frames 54-68 the arm stops close to the chest instead of flowing down and across the body.

zh_Hant.name: 手臂過早彎曲且跟隨動作過短
zh_Hant.details: 在第46幀時，擊球肘部仍明顯彎曲，而在第54到68幀時，手臂停在靠近胸部的位置，而不是自然地向下並橫跨身體。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 完全向上伸展，使肘部在擊球時伸直，然後讓手臂放鬆，完成揮拍至對側臀部。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早停止手臂動作可能會降低羽球的高度和距離，並可能對肩膀造成壓力。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 高球餵球練習：專注於「伸展-擊球-放鬆」，讓球拍尖端在擊球後指向下方，20個羽球。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在擊球時，前臂和上臂形成銳角；跟隨動作的幀數顯示肘部保持在軀幹前方，而不是完全伸展。

findings.actionable_cue: Reach fully upward so the elbow straightens at contact, then let the arm relax and finish past the opposite hip.
findings.why_it_matters: Stopping the arm early can reduce shuttle height and distance and may strain the shoulder.
findings.suggested_drill: High-feed clear drill: focus on ‘reach-hit-relax’, letting the racket tip point down after contact, 20 shuttles.
findings.observed_evidence: Forearm and upper-arm segments form an acute angle at contact; follow-through frames show elbow kept in front of torso rather than extended.
