zh_Hant.summary: 你的手臂動作很積極，但影片顯示下半身支撐不足，肩膀轉動有限，並且揮拍後的跟隨動作過早停止。加入全身旋轉，在擊球時達到更高的位置，並讓球拍自然完成揮拍，將有助於你以更少的力氣將球打得更深遠。

overview.title: Coaching review
overview.summary: Your arm action is active, but the video shows very little lower-body support, limited shoulder turn, and an early stop of the follow-through. Adding full body rotation, reaching higher at contact, and allowing the racket to finish naturally will help you send the shuttle deeper with less effort.

zh_Hant.summary: 你的手臂動作很積極，但影片顯示下半身支撐不足，肩膀轉動有限，並且揮拍後的跟隨動作過早停止。加入全身旋轉，在擊球時達到更高的位置，並讓球拍自然完成揮拍，將有助於你以更少的力氣將球打得更深遠。

coaching_actions.cue: Add full shoulder and hip turn during the backswing

zh_Hant.cue: 在後擺動作中加入完整的肩膀和髖部轉動
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 這提供了輕鬆的球拍速度，並讓你能夠在不額外用力的情況下進行更強的向上揮拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作影子高遠球，誇張的軀幹旋轉，3組，每組10次。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: This supplies easy racket speed and positions you for a stronger upward swing without extra arm effort.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Slow-motion shadow clears with exaggerated torso rotation, 3 sets of 10.

coaching_actions.cue: Use a scissor step to drive upward and recover

zh_Hant.cue: 使用剪步向上推進並恢復。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 腿部推進增加力量，並確保你保持平衡，準備迎接下一拍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 步法梯：剪步進入後場影子高遠球，回到基礎位置，30秒 × 5輪。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Leg drive increases power and ensures you are balanced and ready for the next shot.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Footwork ladder: scissor step into rear-court shadow clear, recover to base, 30 seconds × 5 rounds.

coaching_actions.cue: Reach to full arm extension before and at contact

zh_Hant.cue: 在擊球前和擊球時伸展手臂至完全伸直。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 在最高點擊球能讓高遠球飛得更深，並讓對手處於被動狀態。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 教練餵高球，專注於擊球時手肘伸直，3組，每組15個球。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Hitting at maximum height makes the clear travel deeper and keeps opponents on the back foot.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Coach feed high shuttles, focus on straight elbow at strike, 3 sets of 15 shuttles.

confirmed_findings.name: Minimal trunk and hip rotation
confirmed_findings.details: During frames 14-27 your shoulders and hips stay almost square; the torso shows only a small turn while the racket arm moves back.

zh_Hant.name: 軀幹和髖部旋轉幅度有限
zh_Hant.details: 在第14到27幀期間，你的肩膀和髖部幾乎保持平行；軀幹僅有輕微的轉動，而持拍手臂向後移動。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 當你將球拍向後拉時，讓肚臍和胸部轉動，使非持拍肩膀指向羽球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 如果缺乏更大的軀幹纏繞，你主要依賴手臂發力，這可能會限制力量，並在後場受壓時增加擊球的難度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢速模擬揮拍並誇張肩膀和髖部的轉動：側身站立，完全旋轉，然後揮拍，10次一組，共3組。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 肩膀和髖部的骨架線條幾乎與螢幕平行，而不是進行纏繞動作。

confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: As you take the racket back, allow your belly-button and chest to turn so the non-racket shoulder points toward the shuttle.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Without a bigger torso coil you rely mainly on the arm, which can limit power and make timing harder when you are under pressure in the rearcourt.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Shadow swing with slow, exaggerated shoulder-hip turn: set up sideways, rotate fully, then swing, 10 reps × 3 sets.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton lines for both shoulders and hips remain nearly parallel to the screen rather than winding up.

confirmed_findings.name: Limited weight transfer / no scissor step
confirmed_findings.details: Across all frames the feet stay almost parallel and shoulder-width; there is no visible back-to-front leg switch or push-off.

zh_Hant.name: 重量轉移有限 / 沒有剪步動作
zh_Hant.details: 在所有幀中，雙腳幾乎保持平行且與肩同寬；沒有明顯的前後腿交換或蹬地動作。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球時用後腿蹬地，並在空中交換雙腳，著地時用相反的腿支撐。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 剪步或弓步有助於產生向上的力量，平衡空中的身體，並讓你在高遠球後更快恢復準備姿勢。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 模擬高遠球並標記著地點：跳起、剪步、前腳著地，然後恢復，左右各8次。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 從第0幀到第54幀，腿部線條顯示相似的位置；沒有交叉或著地變化的跡象。

confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Push off your back leg and switch your feet in the air as you hit, landing on the opposite leg.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: A scissor or lunge helps generate upward force, balances the body in the air, and gets you ready to recover after the clear.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Shadow clears with a marked landing spot: jump, scissor, land on front foot, then recover, 8 reps each side.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Leg lines show similar positions from frame 0 through 54; no crossing or landing change is seen.

confirmed_findings.name: Early arm flexion and short follow-through
confirmed_findings.details: At frame 46 the hitting elbow is still noticeably bent and by frames 54-68 the arm stops close to the chest instead of flowing down and across the body.

zh_Hant.name: 手臂過早彎曲且跟隨動作過短
zh_Hant.details: 在第46幀時，擊球肘部仍明顯彎曲，而在第54到68幀時，手臂停在靠近胸部的位置，而不是自然地向下並橫跨身體。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 完全向上伸展，使肘部在擊球時伸直，然後讓手臂放鬆，完成揮拍至對側臀部。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早停止手臂動作可能會降低羽球的高度和距離，並可能對肩膀造成壓力。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 高球餵球練習：專注於「伸展-擊球-放鬆」，讓球拍尖端在擊球後指向下方，20個羽球。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在擊球時，前臂和上臂形成銳角；跟隨動作的幀數顯示肘部保持在軀幹前方，而不是完全伸展。

confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Reach fully upward so the elbow straightens at contact, then let the arm relax and finish past the opposite hip.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Stopping the arm early can reduce shuttle height and distance and may strain the shoulder.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: High-feed clear drill: focus on ‘reach-hit-relax’, letting the racket tip point down after contact, 20 shuttles.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Forearm and upper-arm segments form an acute angle at contact; follow-through frames show elbow kept in front of torso rather than extended.

coaching_output.summary: Your forehand clear shows good weight transfer from the back (right) foot to the front (left) foot, but three areas stand out: the non-racket arm drops too soon, the body does not fully extend at contact, and some upper-arm muscles fire early instead of during the forward swing. Cleaning these up should help you create a higher contact point and a smoother acceleration through the shuttle.

findings.name: Non-racket arm drops early
findings.details: At frame 46 your left arm is already down by your side while the racket is still striking overhead.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手過早下垂
zh_Hant.details: 在第46幀時，你的左手已經垂在身旁，而球拍仍在頭頂擊球。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 用左手向羽球伸展，並在聽到擊球聲後才讓手臂折疊。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 保持非持拍手在擊球前舉起有助於強力旋轉軀幹，並保持身體平衡以進行受控的後續動作。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前進行影子揮拍：在揮拍頂端雙手舉起並停留一秒，然後完成後續動作。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 骨架模型顯示左手在擊球時下垂且彎曲，而不是指向上方。

findings.actionable_cue: Reach up with your left hand toward the shuttle and only let it fold after you hear the hit.
findings.why_it_matters: Keeping the non-racket arm up until contact helps you rotate the torso powerfully and keeps the body balanced for a controlled follow-through.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow swing in front of a mirror: freeze for one second at the top of the swing with both arms up, then complete the follow-through.
findings.observed_evidence: The stick-skeleton shows the left arm lowered and bent at contact instead of pointing upward.

findings.name: Limited body extension at contact
findings.details: Knees stay flexed and the torso remains nearly upright; there is no visible upward reach or jump at frame 46.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球時身體伸展有限
zh_Hant.details: 膝蓋保持彎曲，軀幹幾乎直立；在第46幀時沒有明顯的向上伸展或跳躍。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在擊球前通過後腿推力並伸直臀部，就像試圖讓自己變得更高一樣。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 通過腿部和軀幹的完全伸展可以提高擊球點，並將更多的動能傳遞到羽球上，實現更深的高遠球。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 半場高遠球練習，專注於“伸展和增高”：從稍低的站姿開始，誇張地完成高姿勢，並請搭檔確認你的手臂高度。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 骨架幀顯示從後揮拍到擊球時身體高度變化不大。鞋墊壓力跡象顯示有壓力轉移，但沒有明顯的垂直衝力。

findings.actionable_cue: Push through the back leg and straighten your hips just before the strike, as if trying to make yourself taller.
findings.why_it_matters: Fully extending through the legs and torso raises your contact point and transfers more kinetic energy into the shuttle for a deeper clear.
findings.suggested_drill: Half-court clear with focus on ‘reach and grow’: start in a slightly lower stance and exaggerate a tall finish, asking a partner to confirm your arm height.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton frames show little change in body height between backswing and contact. Insole traces indicate pressure shift but no clear vertical impulse.

findings.name: Early peak in upper-arm muscle activity
findings.details: Upper EMG channels 4 and 5 spike around frames 20–30 and fall off by the contact frame 46.

zh_Hant.name: 上臂肌肉活動峰值過早
zh_Hant.details: 上臂肌電圖第4和第5通道在第20至30幀時出現峰值，並在第46幀擊球時下降。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在後揮拍時保持放鬆，只有在球拍開始向前揮拍時才用力收縮。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早施加肌肉力量會使手臂在後揮拍時緊張，並減少擊球階段的加速，從而降低力量和時機。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢快節奏練習：慢慢向後揮拍，數“一二”，然後在數“三”時快速向前揮拍，感受手臂僅在最後一拍時緊張。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 繪製的肌電圖波形顯示其最高振幅出現在後揮拍期間，而在第40至50幀的前揮拍期間明顯較低。

findings.actionable_cue: Stay relaxed in the take-back and contract hard only as the racket starts to come forward.
findings.why_it_matters: Muscle effort applied too early can make the arm tense in the backswing and leave less acceleration for the hitting phase, reducing power and timing.
findings.suggested_drill: Slow-fast rhythm drill: swing back slowly counting ‘one-two’, then snap forward quickly on ‘three’, feeling the arm tighten only on the last count.
findings.observed_evidence: The plotted EMG waveforms show their highest amplitudes during the backswing, with noticeably lower values during forward-swing frames 40–50.

findings.name: Abrupt back-foot unloading
findings.details: Right-foot insole plots drop sharply between frames 35–45, indicating a quick loss of pressure just before contact.

zh_Hant.name: 後腳卸力突然
zh_Hant.details: 右腳鞋墊的壓力圖在第35至45幀之間急劇下降，顯示在接觸前壓力迅速減少。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 讓右腳在髖部完成旋轉時逐漸離地。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 如果後腳離地過於突然，可能會失去穩定的基礎，限制驅動揮拍的髖部旋轉。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作步法練習影子高遠球：練習從右腳前掌滾動到腳趾，同時完成揮拍。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 多個右腳鞋墊通道顯示壓力急劇下降，而不是平滑的減少，發生在前揮拍過程中。

findings.actionable_cue: Let the right foot peel off the floor gradually while your hips finish rotating.
findings.why_it_matters: If the back foot leaves the floor too abruptly, you may lose a stable base and limit the hip rotation that drives the stroke.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow clear with slow-motion footwork: practise rolling from the ball of the right foot to the toe while completing the swing.
findings.observed_evidence: Multiple right-insole channels show a steep decline rather than a smooth roll-off during the forward swing.

coaching_actions.cue: Extend through legs and torso into the hit.

zh_Hant.cue: 通過腿部和軀幹延伸完成擊球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 較高的接觸點可以讓你打出更陡、更深的高遠球，而不需要額外的手臂力量。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A higher contact point gives you a steeper, deeper clear without extra arm effort.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: ‘Reach and grow’ clears: start low, then deliberately straighten knees and hips while striking, aiming to hear your shoes leave the floor lightly.

coaching_actions.cue: Relax the racket arm on the backswing, fire late.

zh_Hant.cue: 在後揮拍時放鬆持拍手臂，延遲發力。

zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢快節奏訓練：數“慢-慢-快”，僅在“快”的前揮拍時收緊手臂。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Late acceleration conserves energy for the shuttle and reduces unnecessary tension.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Slow-fast rhythm drill: count ‘slow-slow-fast’, tightening the arm only on the ‘fast’ forward swing.

zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作步法練習影子高遠球：練習從右腳前掌滾動到腳趾，同時完成揮拍。

confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Let the right foot peel off the floor gradually while your hips finish rotating.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: If the back foot leaves the floor too abruptly, you may lose a stable base and limit the hip rotation that drives the stroke.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Shadow clear with slow-motion footwork: practise rolling from the ball of the right foot to the toe while completing the swing.

During your backswing you leave the left arm folded close to your ribcage. Reach it outward and slightly upward as you turn side-on so your shoulders can separate and you keep your upper body balanced. Think of pointing the left hand toward the shuttle while the racket loads behind you—the arm is a counterweight that lets your trunk rotate freely. During your forward-swing you keep your left (non-racket) elbow folded close to your ribs rather than letting that arm reach out and away from the body. Allow the left arm to extend and open as you swing – think of it as a counter-weight that helps you stay centred and lets your trunk turn smoothly through the shot. Through your follow-through the hitting arm stays bent and tucked near your right side instead of relaxing outward. Let the elbow open and allow the hand to travel away from the body so the arm can finish long and loose. After you strike the shuttle, you continue to load both feet almost equally instead of finishing the scissor kick on your non-racket (left) foot. From the very first landing frame through the rest of the follow-through, pressure and centre-of-pressure stay split between the two soles. Commit to finishing the jump on the left foot so your body can rotate and begin recovering toward the base more smoothly.

Open your left arm out and point it upward as you load the racket. Let your left arm stretch out as you swing to keep you balanced in the air. Allow your racket arm to fall long and away from your body after you hit. Finish the stroke by landing cleanly on your left foot, letting the right foot touch down light and ready to push back in.

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review

zh_Hant.summary:
過早的上臂防守；平足的分腿步；被動的非持拍手；上臂在後擺中的過度驅動；動力鏈反轉（上半身領先腿部）；前腳掌推進力弱；擊球時重心後移；擊球點較低；擊球時手肘彎曲；擊球後前臂長時間緊張；軀幹過度旋轉。

在後擺時，你的左臂保持折疊並靠近肋骨。當你側身轉動時，將左臂向外和稍微向上伸展，這樣可以讓你的肩膀分開並保持上半身平衡。想像用左手指向羽毛球，而球拍在你身後準備——左臂是一個平衡配重，讓你的軀幹可以自由旋轉。在前揮時，你的左（非持拍）手肘保持折疊並靠近肋骨，而不是讓左臂伸展並遠離身體。讓左臂在揮拍時伸展和打開——將其視為一個平衡配重，幫助你保持居中，並讓你的軀幹順暢地完成揮拍。在隨揮過程中，持拍手臂保持彎曲並靠近右側，而不是放鬆向外。讓手肘打開，並讓手遠離身體，這樣手臂可以完成一個長而放鬆的動作。在擊球後，你繼續將重量幾乎平均分配在雙腳上，而不是在非持拍（左）腳上完成剪刀步。從第一次落地到隨後的隨揮過程中，壓力和重心始終分散在兩腳之間。專注於在左腳上完成跳躍，這樣你的身體可以更順暢地旋轉並開始向基礎位置恢復。

在準備揮拍時，將左臂打開並指向上方。揮拍時讓左臂伸展，保持空中平衡。擊球後讓持拍手臂放鬆並遠離身體。完成動作時，乾淨地落在左腳上，讓右腳輕輕著地，準備推回。

Through your follow-through the hitting arm stays bent and tucked near your right side instead of relaxing outward. Let the elbow open and allow the hand to travel away from the body so the arm can finish long and loose. After you strike the shuttle, you continue to load both feet almost equally instead of finishing the scissor kick on your non-racket (left) foot. From the very first landing frame through the rest of the follow-through, pressure and centre-of-pressure stay split between the two soles. Commit to finishing the jump on the left foot so your body can rotate and begin recovering toward the base more smoothly.

Open your left arm out and point it upward as you load the racket. Let your left arm stretch out as you swing to keep you balanced in the air. Allow your racket arm to fall long and away from your body after you hit. Finish the stroke by landing cleanly on your left foot, letting the right foot touch down light and ready to push back in.

過早的上臂防守；平足的分腿步；被動的非持拍手；上臂在後擺中的過度驅動；動力鏈反轉（上半身領先腿部）；前腳掌推進力弱；擊球時重心後移；擊球點較低；擊球時手肘彎曲；擊球後前臂長時間緊張；軀幹過度旋轉。

在後擺時，你的左臂保持折疊並靠近肋骨。當你側身轉動時，將左臂向外和稍微向上伸展，這樣可以讓你的肩膀分開並保持上半身平衡。想像用左手指向羽毛球，而球拍在你身後準備——左臂是一個平衡配重，讓你的軀幹可以自由旋轉。在前揮時，你的左（非持拍）手肘保持折疊並靠近肋骨，而不是讓左臂伸展並遠離身體。讓左臂在揮拍時伸展和打開——將其視為一個平衡配重，幫助你保持居中，並讓你的軀幹順暢地完成揮拍。在隨揮過程中，持拍手臂保持彎曲並靠近右側，而不是放鬆向外。讓手肘打開，並讓手遠離身體，這樣手臂可以完成一個長而放鬆的動作。在擊球後，你繼續將重量幾乎平均分配在雙腳上，而不是在非持拍（左）腳上完成剪刀步。從第一次落地到隨後的隨揮過程中，壓力和重心始終分散在兩腳之間。專注於在左腳上完成跳躍，這樣你的身體可以更順暢地旋轉並開始向基礎位置恢復。

在準備揮拍時，將左臂打開並指向上方。揮拍時讓左臂伸展，保持空中平衡。擊球後讓持拍手臂放鬆並遠離身體。完成動作時，乾淨地落在左腳上，讓右腳輕輕著地，準備推回。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: An open non-racket arm gives you better rotational control and helps stabilise the trunk during the powerful overhead motion.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow-swing clears while exaggerating the left arm reaching out sideways, focusing on feeling the chest stay broad through the hit.

zh_Hant.cue: 擊球後讓持拍手臂自然放鬆並遠離身體。

zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子揮拍時專注於讓手臂在擊球點後自由擺動，完成時手指向目標，然後再回到原位。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A full, relaxed follow-through helps you dissipate swing momentum smoothly and avoids unnecessary tension in the shoulder and elbow.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow clears focusing on letting the arm swing freely past the contact point, finishing with the hand pointing toward the target before returning.

coaching_actions.cue: Finish the stroke by landing cleanly on your left foot, letting the right foot touch down light and ready to push back in.

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A decisive single-foot landing lets your hips unwind, absorbs impact efficiently, and sets you up for a quicker recovery toward centre court.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow the scissor-kick clear: jump, switch legs in the air, and land strongly on the left foot while keeping the right foot light and ready to step forward.

level2_coach_explanations.text: Premature Upper-Arm Guarding may contribute to Upper-Arm Overdrive in Backswing. Both errors were independently confirmed from raw evidence.
level2_coach_explanations.rationale: Early tonic activation shortens the pectoral/deltoid stretch; during the racket drop the player must continue using active muscle force to move the arm, perpetuating high EMG levels.

zh_Hant.rationale: 過早的張力啟動縮短了胸大肌/三角肌的伸展；在持拍手下落過程中，球員必須繼續使用主動肌肉力量移動手臂，導致肌電圖（EMG）水平持續偏高。

level2_coach_explanations.text: Weak Forefoot Push-Off may contribute to Low Contact Point. Both errors were independently confirmed from raw evidence.
level2_coach_explanations.rationale: With limited upward propulsion the hitting reach height is reduced, lowering the impact point.

zh_Hant.rationale: 由於向上推進力有限，擊球高度降低，導致擊球點下降。

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Non-racket arm kept tucked instead of extended for balance
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: During your backswing you leave the left arm folded close to your ribcage. Reach it outward and slightly upward as you turn side-on so your shoulders can separate and you keep your upper body balanced. Think of pointing the left hand toward the shuttle while the racket loads behind you—the arm is a counterweight that lets your trunk rotate freely.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across player frames 1-6 (attachments 2,4,6,8,10,12) the left elbow stays near the torso with the hand resting near the stomach. In the matched expert frames 1-6 (attachments 1,3,5,7,9,11) the left shoulder is abducted and the hand is clearly away from the body throughout the same backswing window.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手保持收攏而非伸展以保持平衡
zh_Hant.details: 在你的後擺動作中，左手保持靠近肋骨。當你側身轉動時，將左手向外和稍微向上伸展，這樣可以讓你的肩膀分開，保持上半身平衡。想像用左手指向羽毛球，而持拍手在身後準備揮拍——手臂是讓軀幹自由旋轉的平衡配重。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在球員的第1-6幀（附件2,4,6,8,10,12）中，左手肘保持靠近軀幹，手停留在腹部附近。而在專家的對應第1-6幀（附件1,3,5,7,9,11）中，左肩外展，手在整個後擺動作中明顯遠離身體。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家保持非持拍手張開，形成寬闊的肩線，而你則保持手臂收攏。這一簡單的手臂位置差異是這一階段兩個動作之間的主要可見區別。

additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert keeps the non-racket arm open, creating a wide shoulder line, while you keep it folded. That simple arm position difference is the main visible change between the two strokes in this phase.

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Non-racket arm tucked instead of extended for counter-balance
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: During your forward-swing you keep your left (non-racket) elbow folded close to your ribs rather than letting that arm reach out and away from the body. Allow the left arm to extend and open as you swing – think of it as a counter-weight that helps you stay centred and lets your trunk turn smoothly through the shot.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: Across player frames 1-4 (source frames 31-37) the left elbow stays flexed and the forearm hugs the torso. In the matched expert frames the same arm is visibly straighter and positioned several coordinate units away from the trunk, forming a wide ‘T’ shape that is absent in the player.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手收起而不是伸展來平衡身體
zh_Hant.details: 在前揮拍時，你的左手（非持拍手）肘部保持靠近肋骨，而不是讓手臂伸展遠離身體。揮拍時讓左手臂伸展並打開——把它想像成一個平衡重心的配重，幫助你保持穩定，並讓軀幹順暢地完成擊球動作。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在球員的第1至第4幀（來源幀31-37）中，左肘保持彎曲，前臂貼近軀幹。而在對應的專家幀中，同一手臂明顯更直，並且位於遠離軀幹的幾個座標單位處，形成一個寬闊的“T”形，這在球員的動作中是缺失的。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家的非持拍手在前揮拍過程中始終向下/向外伸展，形成寬闊的上半身輪廓。而你的手臂保持收起，縮小了輪廓並失去了平衡作用。觀察並排的動作序列可以清楚看到差異：專家的肩膀圍繞穩定的軸線旋轉，而你的肩膀因手臂收起而缺乏平衡，顯得向前傾斜。

additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert’s non-racket arm is extended downward/outward throughout the forward-swing, giving a broad upper-body profile. Your arm remains tucked, narrowing the profile and removing that counter-balance. Observing the side-by-side sequence makes the difference clear: the expert’s shoulders rotate around a stable axis, while your shoulders appear to pitch forward as the tucked arm offers little balance.

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Truncated racket-arm follow-through
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: Through your follow-through the hitting arm stays bent and tucked near your right side instead of relaxing outward. Let the elbow open and allow the hand to travel away from the body so the arm can finish long and loose.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: In every sampled follow-through frame (pairs 2-6) the player’s right elbow remains visibly flexed, with the hand sitting close to the rib/hip line. In the matching expert frames the right elbow is noticeably more open and the forearm projects clear of the torso.

zh_Hant.name: 持拍手的隨揮動作過於縮短
zh_Hant.details: 在隨揮過程中，擊球手臂保持彎曲並靠近右側，而不是放鬆向外延展。讓肘部打開，手遠離身體，讓手臂完成一個長而放鬆的動作。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在每個取樣的隨揮幀（第2至第6對幀）中，球員的右肘明顯保持彎曲，手靠近肋骨/髖部線。而在對應的專家幀中，右肘明顯更為打開，前臂遠離軀幹。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家的右臂在擊球後逐漸伸直，形成前臂與軀幹之間的明顯間隙，而球員的手臂則保持緊貼身體。這種對比在所有顯示的隨揮動作中都很一致。

additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert’s right arm progressively straightens after contact, creating a clear gap between forearm and trunk, while the player’s arm stays compact against the body. The contrast is consistent across all displayed follow-through moments.

additional_visual_hypotheses.name: Two-footed landing instead of decisive scissor-foot transfer
additional_visual_hypotheses.details: After you strike the shuttle, you continue to load both feet almost equally instead of finishing the scissor kick on your non-racket (left) foot. From the very first landing frame through the rest of the follow-through, pressure and centre-of-pressure stay split between the two soles. Commit to finishing the jump on the left foot so your body can rotate and begin recovering toward the base more smoothly.
additional_visual_hypotheses.evidence: In follow-through frames F50, F58, F66, F83, F99 and onward, the insole maps show moderate-to-high pressure patches under BOTH feet and the CoP markers sit near the mid-foot of each shoe. In the matched expert frames at the same times, almost all load and the CoP are on a single foot while the other foot shows only light blue (minimal) pressure.

zh_Hant.name: 雙腳著地而非果斷的剪步轉移
zh_Hant.details: 擊球後，你的雙腳幾乎均勻承重，而不是以非持拍腳（左腳）完成剪步動作。在第一幀著地到隨後的隨揮過程中，壓力和壓力中心分布在兩隻腳掌之間。應該專注於以左腳完成跳躍，這樣你的身體可以更順暢地旋轉並開始向基礎位置恢復。
zh_Hant.evidence: 在隨揮幀F50、F58、F66、F83、F99及之後的幀中，鞋墊壓力圖顯示雙腳底部都有中到高壓力區域，壓力中心標記位於每隻鞋的中腳部附近。而在相同時間的專家幀中，幾乎所有的壓力和壓力中心都集中在單腳，另一隻腳僅顯示淺藍色（最低壓力）。
zh_Hant.expert_comparison: 專家的壓力中心在擊球後立即果斷地轉移到單腳——只有著地腳承受綠色壓力並顯示壓力中心標記，而另一隻鞋幾乎沒有承重。你的壓力圖則顯示雙腳鞋墊上持續存在藍綠色壓力和可見的壓力中心，表明你是雙腳平著地，而不是完成剪步轉換。

additional_visual_hypotheses.expert_comparison: The expert’s CoP shifts decisively onto one foot immediately after contact—only the landing foot carries green pressure and the CoP marker, while the other shoe is nearly unloaded. Your trace keeps blue-green pressure and a visible CoP on both insoles for the entire follow-through, showing that you land flat with two feet instead of completing the scissor switch.

coaching_output.summary:
1. The player’s kinetic chain demonstrates moderate to minor deviations, with a notable lack of efficiency in core activation and upper arm loading. The lower body support is inconsistent, particularly on the left foot, which may limit overall power generation. The wrist and forearm show signs of distal deficiency, impacting shuttle impact quality. Despite these deficits, the player exhibits some potential for improvement in sequencing and load transfer.

2. Starting with the foot, the left-foot support shows a major deviation, indicating a need for stronger ground reaction forces to anchor the lower body. The leg mechanics are somewhat inconsistent, with a slight delay in trunk rotation that could enhance core activation. The core is majorly deviated, which affects the delivery of upper arm drive and lower body support. The upper arm is also showing significant deviation, potentially over-relying on the right arm, which may limit overall balance. The forearm and wrist demonstrate a minor distal deficiency, suggesting a need for greater mobility and drive at the point of impact. 

3. - Drill: Core Activation Drills - Perform 3-4 sets of 12-15 reps of single-leg ground stabilizations with a focus on hip and shoulder rotation. Performance goal: Achieve a 10% improvement in trunk/core activation during the serve.  
- Drill: Lower Body Strength and Rotation - Conduct 2-3 sets of 10-12 reps of lateral jumps with emphasis on hip and knee extension. Performance goal: Maintain proper foot placement and maximize lower body drive during the serve.  
- Drill: Wrist and Forearm Mobility - Execute 4-5 sets of controlled wrist rolls and forearm slalom exercises. Performance goal: Reduce wrist deviation and enhance forehand accuracy.

zh_Hant.summary:
1. 球員的動力鏈顯示出中度至輕微的偏差，核心啟動和上臂負載的效率明顯不足。下肢支撐不穩定，特別是左腳，可能限制整體的力量輸出。手腕和前臂顯示出遠端不足的跡象，影響了擊球的質量。儘管存在這些不足，球員在動作順序和負載轉移方面仍有一定的改進潛力。

2. 從腳開始，左腳支撐顯示出重大偏差，表明需要更強的地面反作用力來穩固下肢。腿部動作機制有些不穩定，軀幹旋轉略有延遲，這可能增強核心啟動。核心存在重大偏差，影響了上臂驅動和下肢支撐的傳遞。上臂也顯示出顯著偏差，可能過度依賴右臂，這可能限制整體平衡。前臂和手腕顯示出輕微的遠端不足，表明需要在擊球點增加更多的靈活性和驅動力。

3. - 訓練：核心啟動訓練 - 進行3-4組，每組12-15次的單腿地面穩定訓練，重點在於髖部和肩部旋轉。表現目標：在發球時核心啟動提高10%。
- 訓練：下肢力量與旋轉 - 進行2-3組，每組10-12次的側向跳躍，重點在於髖部和膝部的伸展。表現目標：保持正確的腳部位置並在發球時最大化下肢驅動。
- 訓練：手腕與前臂靈活性 - 進行4-5組的控制手腕滾動和前臂蛇形運動。表現目標：減少手腕偏差並提高正手擊球的準確性。

coaching_output.summary: Your arm and upper-body positions suggest you are striking the clear lower and flatter than you might like, with little trunk rotation to add length. A few posture and sequencing adjustments can help you reach higher, rotate through the shot, and unload the arm more comfortably.

findings.name: Low contact reach
findings.details: At frame 37 (labelled “forward swing – contact”) your racket-side arm is almost horizontal and well forward of the head instead of being up over the shoulder.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球點較低
zh_Hant.details: 在第37幀（標記為“前揮—擊球”）中，你持拍手臂幾乎呈水平狀態，並且位於頭部前方，而不是在肩膀上方。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 完全伸展手臂——想像“把你的腋下展示給天花板”——然後再揮拍。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 正手高遠球在球拍接觸到羽毛球的時間早且位置高時，能飛得更遠更高。擊球點較低可能會降低羽毛球的高度，浪費時間，並增加肩膀的負擔。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子半場高遠球練習：站在底線上，反覆向頭頂的假想羽毛球跨步並伸展，停留在最大伸展位置後再完成揮拍。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 擊球手臂的線條大致在肩膀高度，肘部略微彎曲；頭部明顯高於擊球手。

findings.actionable_cue: Reach up fully—imagine ‘showing your armpit to the ceiling’—before you swing.
findings.why_it_matters: A forehand clear travels farther and higher when the shuttle is contacted early and high. Striking lower can reduce shuttle height, cost time, and increase strain on the shoulder.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow half-court clears: stand on base-line, repeatedly step and stretch to an overhead imaginary shuttle, freezing at maximum reach before finishing the swing.
findings.observed_evidence: The hitting arm line sits roughly at shoulder height with the elbow slightly bent; the head is visibly above the hitting hand.

findings.name: Limited trunk rotation
findings.details: From frame 14 to 27 the pelvis and shoulders stay mostly square to the net with only the arm moving behind you.

zh_Hant.name: 軀幹旋轉受限
zh_Hant.details: 從第14幀到第27幀，骨盆和肩膀大部分時間保持正對球網，只有手臂在身後移動。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在後擺時轉動非持拍側的髖部和肩膀——想像“把你的背部展示給羽毛球”——然後在擊球時展開。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 旋轉髖部和肩膀可以儲存彈性能量，並讓更大的核心肌肉協助完成高遠球，減少手臂的負擔。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作影子高遠球練習，強調髖部和肩膀的旋轉：誇張地完成後擺（儲能）和前揮（釋能），每組練習10次。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在揮拍的後擺過程中，脊椎線和髖部線幾乎保持平行；兩者之間幾乎沒有扭轉。

findings.actionable_cue: Turn your non-racket hip and shoulder back during the backswing—think ‘show your back to the shuttle’—then unwind into the hit.
findings.why_it_matters: Rotating the hips and shoulders stores elastic energy and lets the bigger core muscles assist the clear, reducing load on the arm alone.
findings.suggested_drill: Slow-motion shadow clears emphasizing hip-shoulder turn: exaggerate the coil (backswing) and uncoil (forward swing) for 10 reps each set.
findings.observed_evidence: The spine line and hip line stay nearly parallel throughout the backswing; little twist is visible between the two.

findings.name: Inactive non-racket arm
findings.details: Throughout the sequence the non-racket arm hangs near the torso rather than pointing upward in preparation or opening for balance after impact.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手臂不活躍
zh_Hant.details: 在整個動作過程中，非持拍手臂垂在身體旁邊，而不是向上指向羽毛球或在擊球後展開以保持平衡。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在揮拍前，用非持拍手指向羽毛球，然後在完成動作時讓它折疊到身體另一側。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 活躍的非持拍手臂可以幫助你追蹤羽毛球，保持平衡，並促進肩膀的完全旋轉和動作恢復。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 鏡子練習：站在鏡子前，練習高遠球，專注於同步指向的手臂與擊球手臂的動作。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在第14幀、第27幀、第37幀以及後續幀中，非持拍手臂垂在身體旁邊，並未抬起。

findings.actionable_cue: Before swinging, point your non-racket hand towards the shuttle, then let it fold across your body as you finish.
findings.why_it_matters: An active non-racket arm helps you track the shuttle, maintain balance, and encourages full shoulder turn and recovery.
findings.suggested_drill: Mirror drill: stand in front of a mirror and rehearse the clear, focusing only on synchronising the pointing arm with the hitting arm.
findings.observed_evidence: In frames 14, 27, 37 and follow-through frames, the non-racket arm is down by your side, not lifted.

zh_Hant.cue: 伸展手臂並在頭頂上方擊球，而不是在肩膀高度擊球。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更高的擊球點可以增加球場的長度，並使高遠球更難被攻擊。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在低天花板或橫樑下練習高遠球：每次揮拍時，確保球拍觸碰到橫樑後再開始揮動，以確保最大伸展範圍。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Higher contact gives you more court length and makes the clear harder to attack.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Shadow clears under a low ceiling or beam: start each swing only when your racket touches the beam, ensuring maximal reach.

coaching_actions.cue: Add hip-shoulder rotation in the backswing then unwind through the hit.

zh_Hant.cue: 在後擺時加入髖部和肩部的旋轉，然後在擊球時展開動作。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 使用核心肌群可以分擔負荷並增加輕鬆的力量。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢-快節奏訓練：先進行三次慢速旋轉的揮拍練習以感受蓄力，然後進行一次全速揮拍，重複兩組，每組十次。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Using your core shares the workload and adds effortless power.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Slow-fast tempo drill: perform three slow rotational shadow swings to feel the coil, then one full-speed swing, repeating for two sets of ten.

coaching_actions.cue: Activate the non-racket arm as a pointer for balance.

zh_Hant.cue: 啟動非持拍手作為平衡的指引。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 引導手臂可以穩定身體並促進完整的上半身轉動。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在上場練習前，進行5分鐘的鏡子練習，刻意用非持拍手指引方向。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A guiding arm stabilises the body and promotes full upper-body turn.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Mirror rehearsal with deliberate non-racket arm pointing for 5 minutes before on-court practice.

confirmed_findings.name: Low contact reach
confirmed_findings.details: At frame 37 (labelled “forward swing – contact”) your racket-side arm is almost horizontal and well forward of the head instead of being up over the shoulder.

zh_Hant.name: 擊球點較低
zh_Hant.details: 在第37幀（標記為“前揮—擊球”）中，你持拍手臂幾乎呈水平狀態，並且位於頭部前方，而不是在肩膀上方。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 完全伸展手臂——想像“把你的腋下展示給天花板”——然後再揮拍。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 正手高遠球在球拍接觸到羽毛球的時間早且位置高時，能飛得更遠更高。擊球點較低可能會降低羽毛球的高度，浪費時間，並增加肩膀的負擔。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 影子半場高遠球練習：站在底線上，反覆向頭頂的假想羽毛球跨步並伸展，停留在最大伸展位置後再完成揮拍。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 擊球手臂的線條大致在肩膀高度，肘部略微彎曲；頭部明顯高於擊球手。

confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Reach up fully—imagine ‘showing your armpit to the ceiling’—before you swing.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: A forehand clear travels farther and higher when the shuttle is contacted early and high. Striking lower can reduce shuttle height, cost time, and increase strain on the shoulder.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Shadow half-court clears: stand on base-line, repeatedly step and stretch to an overhead imaginary shuttle, freezing at maximum reach before finishing the swing.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: The hitting arm line sits roughly at shoulder height with the elbow slightly bent; the head is visibly above the hitting hand.

confirmed_findings.name: Limited trunk rotation
confirmed_findings.details: From frame 14 to 27 the pelvis and shoulders stay mostly square to the net with only the arm moving behind you.

zh_Hant.name: 軀幹旋轉受限
zh_Hant.details: 從第14幀到第27幀，骨盆和肩膀大部分時間保持正對球網，只有手臂在身後移動。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在後擺時轉動非持拍側的髖部和肩膀——想像“把你的背部展示給羽毛球”——然後在擊球時展開。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 旋轉髖部和肩膀可以儲存彈性能量，並讓更大的核心肌肉協助完成高遠球，減少手臂的負擔。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作影子高遠球練習，強調髖部和肩膀的旋轉：誇張地完成後擺（儲能）和前揮（釋能），每組練習10次。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在揮拍的後擺過程中，脊椎線和髖部線幾乎保持平行；兩者之間幾乎沒有扭轉。

confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Turn your non-racket hip and shoulder back during the backswing—think ‘show your back to the shuttle’—then unwind into the hit.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: Rotating the hips and shoulders stores elastic energy and lets the bigger core muscles assist the clear, reducing load on the arm alone.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Slow-motion shadow clears emphasizing hip-shoulder turn: exaggerate the coil (backswing) and uncoil (forward swing) for 10 reps each set.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: The spine line and hip line stay nearly parallel throughout the backswing; little twist is visible between the two.

confirmed_findings.name: Inactive non-racket arm
confirmed_findings.details: Throughout the sequence the non-racket arm hangs near the torso rather than pointing upward in preparation or opening for balance after impact.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手臂不活躍
zh_Hant.details: 在整個動作過程中，非持拍手臂垂在身體旁邊，而不是向上指向羽毛球或在擊球後展開以保持平衡。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在揮拍前，用非持拍手指向羽毛球，然後在完成動作時讓它折疊到身體另一側。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 活躍的非持拍手臂可以幫助你追蹤羽毛球，保持平衡，並促進肩膀的完全旋轉和動作恢復。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 鏡子練習：站在鏡子前，練習高遠球，專注於同步指向的手臂與擊球手臂的動作。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 在第14幀、第27幀、第37幀以及後續幀中，非持拍手臂垂在身體旁邊，並未抬起。

confirmed_findings.actionable_cue: Before swinging, point your non-racket hand towards the shuttle, then let it fold across your body as you finish.
confirmed_findings.why_it_matters: An active non-racket arm helps you track the shuttle, maintain balance, and encourages full shoulder turn and recovery.
confirmed_findings.suggested_drill: Mirror drill: stand in front of a mirror and rehearse the clear, focusing only on synchronising the pointing arm with the hitting arm.
confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: In frames 14, 27, 37 and follow-through frames, the non-racket arm is down by your side, not lifted.

coaching_output.summary: Your clear travels through the court smoothly, but the video and sensor traces show that a larger backswing, a more active non-racket arm and a later push from the back leg could help you create extra height and length. Focusing on keeping acceleration alive right up to contact will also give you a crisper strike.

findings.name: Compact racket-arm backswing
findings.details: In frames 14 and 27 your racket arm stays roughly at shoulder height with the elbow little behind the torso, creating a flat, short arc.

zh_Hant.name: 持拍手臂後擺幅度緊湊
zh_Hant.details: 在第14和27幀中，你的持拍手臂大致保持在肩膀高度，肘部稍微在軀幹後方，形成一個平坦且短的弧線。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 將持拍肘部抬高到頭部後方，讓球拍頭在向前揮拍前稍微下落。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 有限的弧線縮短了加速路徑，降低了高遠球的高度和距離。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 在鏡子前練習高遠球的影子揮拍，停留在高後擺的頂部位置以加深肘部位置的記憶。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 骨架顯示持拍側的肘部幾乎與肩膀平齊，且在後擺時未在頭部後方抬高。

findings.actionable_cue: Lift the racket elbow higher behind your head so the racket head drops slightly before you swing forward.
findings.why_it_matters: A limited arc shortens the acceleration path, reducing shuttle height and distance in the clear.
findings.suggested_drill: Shadow overhead clears in front of a mirror, pausing at the top of a high backswing to engrain elbow position.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton shows the racket-side elbow almost level with the shoulder and not elevated behind the head during backswing.

findings.name: Non-racket arm stays low
findings.details: At contact (frame 37) your free arm is down by your side rather than reaching up or forward.

zh_Hant.name: 非持拍手臂保持低位
zh_Hant.details: 在擊球接觸時（第37幀），你的非持拍手臂位於身旁，而不是向上或向前伸展。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 在揮拍時將非持拍手指向羽球，然後在隨後動作中將其拉下至肋骨旁。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 活躍的對側手臂有助於旋轉軀幹並穩定肩膀，增加高遠球的力量和控制。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 練習“伸手並拉下”的影子揮拍：誇張地抬高非持拍手臂並在擊打假想羽球時將其拉下。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 骨架第27至37幀顯示非持拍手臂幾乎沒有抬高或伸展。

findings.actionable_cue: Point your free hand toward the shuttle as you swing, then pull it down past your ribs during follow-through.
findings.why_it_matters: An active opposite arm helps rotate the trunk and stabilise the shoulders, adding power and control to the clear.
findings.suggested_drill: Practise ‘reach-and-pull’ shadow swings: exaggerate lifting the free arm and pulling it down while striking an imaginary shuttle.
findings.observed_evidence: Skeleton frames 27–37 show minimal elevation or extension of the non-racket arm.

findings.name: Acceleration peaks too early
findings.details: Upper-arm EMG channels 2 and 5 spike around frames 25–30, then decline before the contact frame 37.

zh_Hant.name: 加速峰值過早
zh_Hant.details: 上臂肌電圖第2和第5通道在第25至30幀左右達到峰值，然後在第37幀接觸前下降。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 感受前臂和手腕在羽球前的“甩動”，保持速度在接觸時而不是接觸前持續增加。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早達到努力峰值可能會降低擊球時的球拍速度，限制羽球的清球距離。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 多羽球半場高遠球練習，專注於後期甩動——教練快速餵球，目標是以快速的最後一秒甩動在最高接觸點擊球。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 最大肌電圖峰值出現在接觸紅色標記前約10幀；信號幅度在接觸前下降。

findings.actionable_cue: Feel the forearm and wrist ‘snap’ just before the shuttle, keeping speed building into contact rather than before it.
findings.why_it_matters: Peaking effort too early can reduce racket speed at impact, limiting shuttle clearance distance.
findings.suggested_drill: Multi-shuttle half-court clears focusing on late whip—coach feeds shuttles rapidly while you aim for highest point of contact with a fast last-second snap.
findings.observed_evidence: Largest EMG peaks occur ~10 frames before the red contact marker; signal magnitude drops approaching contact.

findings.name: Weight transfer finishes early
findings.details: Right-foot pressure drops and left-foot pressure peaks before the contact frame, while the torso is already upright by frame 37.

zh_Hant.name: 重心轉移過早完成
zh_Hant.details: 右腳壓力在擊球前下降，左腳壓力在擊球前達到峰值，而軀幹在第37幀時已經直立。
zh_Hant.actionable_cue: 延遲後腳蹬地，確保在球拍擊中羽球時仍在上升並轉移重量。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 過早完成蹬地可能會導致在球拍擊中羽球時缺乏向上或向前的動力，影響力量和場地覆蓋範圍。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 分步進入跨步高遠球：先進行小分步，教練拍手時用後腿蹬地，擊球時感覺重量持續上升到前腳。
zh_Hant.observed_evidence: 鞋墊追蹤顯示右腳負荷在第30幀左右急劇下降；左腳負荷在擊球前達到峰值。骨架顯示在擊球時向上的動力有限。

findings.actionable_cue: Delay the back-foot push so you are still rising and transferring weight as the racket meets the shuttle.
findings.why_it_matters: Completing the push-off too soon can leave you without upward or forward drive when the racket meets the shuttle, costing power and court coverage.
findings.suggested_drill: Split-step into lunging clears: start with small split, push off back leg on coach’s clap, strike while feeling continuous rise onto the front foot.
findings.observed_evidence: Insole traces show right foot load decreasing sharply around frame 30; left foot load peaks just before contact. Skeleton shows limited upward drive at contact.

coaching_output.headline: Coaching review

zh_Hant.summary: 你的高遠球在場地上移動得很順暢，但影片和感測器追蹤顯示，增加揮拍的後擺幅度、更活躍的非持拍手臂，以及稍晚的後腿推力，可能有助於增加球的高度和距離。專注於保持加速直到擊球接觸，還能讓你的擊球更乾脆。

coaching_actions.cue: Raise the elbow higher in backswing and accelerate right up to contact.

zh_Hant.cue: 在後擺時將肘部抬高，並加速直到擊球瞬間。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 更長的揮拍路徑結合後期加速，可以在不額外用力的情況下增加速度和高度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 模仿影子高遠球時誇張地抬高肘部，然後進行餵球—影子—餵球的序列練習，將高後擺融入實際羽球擊球中。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: A longer swing path combined with late acceleration adds speed and height without extra effort.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Mirror shadow clears with exaggerated high elbow, then feed – shadow – feed sequences to blend the high backswing into live shuttles.

coaching_actions.cue: Use your non-racket arm to guide and balance the stroke.

zh_Hant.cue: 使用非持拍手引導並平衡擊球動作。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 主動的反手臂動作可以穩定肩膀，並幫助全身旋轉以打出更遠的高遠球。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Active opposite-arm movement stabilises the shoulders and helps full-body rotation for lengthier clears.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: ‘Reach-point’ drill: coach calls ‘point’, you freeze with free arm extended and racket ready, then resume swing.

coaching_actions.cue: Push off the back leg a beat later so weight is still moving at contact.

zh_Hant.cue: 後腿蹬地稍微延遲一拍，確保在擊球時重量仍在移動。
zh_Hant.why_it_matters: 腿部的後期動力將地面力量傳導到球拍，改善擊球深度。
zh_Hant.suggested_drill: 慢動作步法揮拍：按節拍器的節奏進行步伐、停頓，然後蹬地並揮拍，感受腿部動力的時機。

coaching_actions.why_it_matters: Late drive from the legs channels ground force into the racket, improving depth.
coaching_actions.suggested_drill: Slow-motion footwork swings: step, hold, then push and swing on a metronome count to feel timed leg drive.

confirmed_findings.observed_evidence: Insole traces show right foot load decreasing sharply around frame 30; left foot load peaks just before contact. Skeleton shows limited upward drive at contact.
